jobs.title: Research Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179954 **Category** Administration
  
In order for your application to be considered, please attached a cover letter and CV to your employment application.


**Position Description**


The Schaeffer Institute is seeking a **Research Program Specialist** to provide high\-level administrative leadership for the USC Mann Department of Pharmaceutical \& Health Economics, and to take on new programmatic support for the Institute leadership team and its growing modeling research program. Working with established and up\-and\-coming scholars, the **Research Program Specialist** will develop and spearhead new procedures and processes to support an in\-demand research team and their work with sophisticated data and modeling tools developed at the Institute. The **Research Program Specialist** will assist in program development and ensure that deadlines and milestones are met. The position will report to the Schaeffer Institute Director of Operations (in coordination with respective departmental leadership), who will help oversee the portfolio of work and ensure a collaborative and creative work environment across teams. The right candidate will contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape priorities to ensure leadership and program success.


This position offers a unique opportunity in the substantive work of a policy research center and an important academic department. The right candidate will have administrative expertise, high attention to detail, and enthusiasm for supporting a robust research agenda, faculty activities, and student engagement. The Schaeffer Institute serves a varied group of internal and external constituents—including students, academics, executives, philanthropists, and leading policymakers and staffers—across the political spectrum. Demonstrated experience working with leading faculty and scholars to support research goals is a plus.


**Research Program Leadership**


* Coordinate administrative functions for the modeling research program and other research initiatives as directed by Schaeffer leadership, including acting as a point of contact, responding to requests and inquiries, and managing program content.
* Assist program leadership and key stakeholders with anaylsis, research, and presentations.
* Manage program deadlines; coordinating and tracking grants, projects, and timelines to ensure deliverables and milestones are met.
* Support reporting and proposal development, including budget tracking, grant submissions, and compliance processes.
* Coordinate and contribute to research studies, proposals, and grant\-related research activities.
* Contribute to administrative leadership team meetings and support to Schaeffer academic and policy programming as time allows.

**Department Leadership**


* Oversee Department Chair’s administrative duties by managing calendars, coordinating meetings, preparing course materials, and assisting with day\-to\-day departmental operations for leading faculty.
* Organize departmental events, including conferences, seminars, special events and faculty meetings by managing logistics, vendor communications, facilities, catering, guest accommodations, and event execution.
* Collaborate with the USC Mann communications department to maintain and update the department website, ensuring accurate content, multimedia displays, and compliance with program policies.
* Execute two full\-cycle faculty recruitment searches by arranging candidate travel, accommodations, campus itineraries, interview schedules, and job talks; contributing to the successful hiring of two junior faculty members.
* Lead academic program services and activities including course scheduling, student recruitment initiatives, student summer programs, graduate program’s brown bag series, prospective student visit days, and new student orientation.
* Support graduate students’ academic progress by coordinating dissertation defenses, including scheduling, room reservations, logistics, technology setup, and day\-of\-event coordination to ensure successful execution.
* Act as the liaison between graduate students and the GAO, facilitating effective communication and ensuring students receive accurate information and support throughout their time in the program.
* Manage department faculty, students, and Schaeffer Center member travel, travel reimbursements.
* Process journal publication fees, manuscript edits, and purchase research materials while ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.

**Minimum Education:**


Bachelor’s degree


**Minimum Experience:**


2 years of relevant experience


**Compensation**


Commensurate with experience and qualifications. Position is 100% FTE


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.


The hourly rate range for this position is $40\.95 \- $46\.28\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.


**Work Arrangement**


Expected to work onsite 2\-3 days per week at USC University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA


**Fixed Term Position**


This is a full time, fixed term position through June 30, 2029 (with the possibility of renewal) with a hybrid work arrangement


**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**


The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy \& Government Service develops evidence\-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator - Los Angeles (Hybrid, Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT COLAB**

Colab Marketing Group is a field marketing agency that staffs and runs live brand activations \- tastings, launches, festivals, retail demos \- for spirits, beer, cannabis, wellness and lifestyle brands. We're headquartered in Denver with a growing Los Angeles program and a national footprint.

**THE ROLE**

You'll be our operations person on the ground in LA, working with our Operations Manager to keep California events staffed, confirmed and running. Mornings you'll send day\-of check\-ins and confirm the week ahead. When a brand ambassador drops or a client adds something late, you fill the gap and keep everyone informed. Every other week you'll spend a half\-day with our team at our coworking space in LA, and you'll be at select activations to see how they run.

This is a new seat. It starts part\-time and grows with our event volume, and the person who owns it well moves up with us.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Confirm shifts and run day\-of check\-ins with field teams
* Fill open shifts from our roster, and flag early when one won't fill
* Handle no\-shows and last\-minute changes, and keep the client informed with a solution, not a problem
* Answer team questions during your coverage blocks so nothing sits unanswered
* Be on site at select LA activations, and at our coworking space every other week
* Log what happened so the next person never has to guess

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* You live in the LA area and can be in person on the days we set together
* Self\-directed and fast \- you act when something comes up, not later
* Clear, professional written communication
* Honest about problems and mistakes, including your own
* Steady when plans change
* Available for some evening and weekend blocks; we set them in advance
* Coordination, staffing, hospitality or event experience is a plus. Reliability matters more than resume.

**HOURS AND PAY**

* About 20 hours a week to start, set weekly, heavier during big activation weeks
* $25/hour plus performance incentives
* Hybrid: most of the work is from wherever you are; in\-person days in LA as scheduled
* Training on how our events run before you run one

**HOW TO APPLY**

Reply with a short note, three to five sentences: why this role, what you've done that's closest to it, and one time you fixed something that went sideways at work. Then tell us the neighborhood you live in. A short, specific note beats a long resume.

Pay: From $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have reliable transportation, and are you 21 or older? Yes or no to each. (Most of our clients are spirits and beer brands.)
* Can you be on site in Los Angeles on the days we set together, including some evenings and weekends? Answer yes or no, and tell us which days are hardest for you.

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Required)
* Night Shift (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90026 (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90026

jobs.title: Customer Success Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Home From College**
---------------------------


Home From College (H\\FC) is redefining how brands connect with the next generation of talent and consumers. With over 500,000 Gen Z students across every major U.S. campus and 1,000\+ brand partners including Uber, Poppi, and Etsy, we're building the leading platform where students turn creativity into opportunity—and where brands authentically show up on campus and online.


Backed by Google Ventures and leading investors, we're in a stage of rapid growth and are looking for a Customer Success Coordinator to help scale the operational engine behind every campaign we run. This role sits on the Customer Success team with close partnership across GTM, Sales, and Product.

**The Role**
------------


We're seeking a Brand Success Coordinator to keep brand accounts moving — owning the day\-to\-day execution that gets students recruited, work reviewed, and campaigns delivered on time.


This role is the operational core of how H\\FC delivers for brands. You'll review submissions against brand briefs, recruit and follow up with student participants, collect and verify live content links, and build the tasks that turn a brand brief into completed work. It's high\-volume, fast\-turnaround, and standards\-driven: when it's done well, students get paid on time, brands see momentum, and the CS team stays focused on relationships and growth.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **microGIG Submission Review:** Review student submissions against the brief and approve, request revisions, or reject. Apply consistent quality standards and flag edge cases to CS rather than guessing.
* **Participant Recruiting:** Source and invite students into open microGIGs based on brand fit and requirements. Follow up with students who haven't accepted or started, and backfill drop\-offs to keep GIGs fully staffed.
* **Content Link Collection:** Chase and confirm live links for published content across platforms. Verify links are live, correct, and attached to the right submission, and escalate unresponsive students after standard follow\-up.
* **Task Creation \& Management:** Build and assign participant tasks from brand briefs. Keep task details, deadlines, and deliverables accurate in the platform, and update or close tasks as scope shifts.
* **Account Support \& Risk Flagging:** Keep account records and trackers current. Surface risks early — stalled GIGs, unresponsive participants, brands going quiet — so CS hears about problems from you, not from the brand.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, coordination, customer support, or community management — ideally at a marketplace, creator platform, or high\-growth consumer company.
* Extremely reliable and responsive; this role is critical for student payouts and brand deadlines.
* Strong written communication — a lot of this job is clear follow\-up with students and brands.
* Detail\-oriented and genuinely comfortable with repetitive, checklist\-driven work at scale.
* Good judgment on when to decide and when to escalate.
* Comfortable in a dashboard, spreadsheets, Slack, and within AI tools.
* Bonus: experience with creator or influencer programs, marketplace operations, or campus and student communities.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive annual base compensation
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan

Parking Administrative Coordinator – Lucas Museum of Narrative Art  

Los Angeles, CA \| Full\-time \| $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour (DOE)


About the Museum  

Opening September 2026, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is the first museum dedicated to visual storytelling. Located in Exposition Park, we're looking for a Parking Administrative Coordinator to manage the behind\-the\-scenes operations that keep our parking running smoothly — ensuring every guest has a seamless experience from the moment they arrive.


Our Culture  

We believe great service starts with great people. Our team thrives on taking pride in their work, staying calm when things get busy, showing up because the team counts on them, and supporting each other.  

We invest in our people and treat every role as essential.


The Position  

You are the organizational backbone of our parking operation. As the Parking Administrative Coordinator, you'll manage the SKIDATA parking access and revenue control system, process invoices and validations, handle customer and tenant account requests, and ensure accurate revenue reporting. You're the go\-to person for walk\-in, phone, and email inquiries — keeping everything accurate, organized, and running smoothly behind the scenes.

* Validate vendor invoices against SKIDATA reports, contracts, and rate schedules

What We Offer

* Pay: $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full\-time schedule with consistent weekly hours
* A supportive team culture that treats every role as essential
* Growth opportunities — many supervisors and managers started in operational roles

### **Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum age 18 or older
* SKIDATA PARCS experience strongly preferred; other PARCS platforms considered
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers and records
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Clear, professional communication skills — by phone, email, and in person
* Ability to organize, prioritize, and track multiple tasks with minimal supervision
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial, payment, and personal information


Preferred:

Key Traits:

* Detail\-oriented and accurate
* Customer\-focused and professional
* Calm under pressure and reliable

At Observable Space, we're redefining how humanity observes and connects with the universe. We're a vertically integrated, high\-growth, space technology company building industry\-leading precision optics platforms for Earth and in space. Our systems are trusted by thousands of customers, including NASA, JPL, SpaceX, Boeing, RTX, the US Space Force and the U.S. Department of War, leading research institutions and international partners.


We combine precision opto\-mechanical hardware, embedded compute, cloud orchestration, and developer\-friendly APIs into world class products at scale with in\-house manufacturing. From advanced ground stations, on\-orbit sensor suites, free space optical lasercom, to distributed compute platforms, we deliver the foundational systems enabling continuous, real\-time navigation, observation, and communication in space.

About Hollywood Park
Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed\-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world\-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.
  

  

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3\.1 million\-square\-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor\-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record\-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28\), along with being converted into the largest Olympic swimming venue in history.  

  

Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2\.5\-acre open\-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000\-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state\-of\-the\-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line\-up of chart\-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must\-play destination.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Stic is modernizing out\-of\-home, one of advertising's oldest formats. Billboards and transit ads have always sold impressions on faith. Stic replaces faith by turning everyday vehicles into GPS\-tracked, mobile media. Brands get proof instead of best guesses. Drivers earn passive income on miles they're already driving.


Stic Vision is how it works. An edge AI device small enough to live inside a decal, streaming informative analytics with no vehicle\-level integration required.


The global out\-of\-home advertising market is worth roughly $40 billion a year. Stic is building the measurement layer that legacy OOH never had.


Stic is trusted by brands like TikTok, Dunkin Donuts, e.l.f., and PacSun. The traction is already showing up in results: a SXSW campaign for TikTok Radio put 44 vehicles on the road in Austin and generated 3\.9 million tracked impressions. That's real, revenue\-generating proof in a category still mostly sold on assumptions.


Stic is lean by design. People joining now build the playbook rather than inheriting one. This means fast execution, without the layers of process that slow down bigger companies.

**About You**

jobs.description:
**Assistant Media Planner \& Buyer \| Podcast \& Paid Social**

**Camp Gravy \| Los Angeles, CA, Part\-time \- likely to grow into a full\-time role**

Camp Gravy is looking for an organized, proactive Assistant Media Planner \& Buyer with **1\+ years of relevant experience** to support advertising campaigns, with an emphasis on **podcast ad buying and hands on paid social campaign management**.

You’ll work directly with the founder to research advertising opportunities, coordinate podcast placements, manage campaigns in social media advertising platforms, and track results. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys both relationship\-driven media buying and data\-driven campaign optimization.

The position will start part\-time and is **likely to grow into a full\-time role** as the business and your responsibilities expand. Los Angeles based candidates preferred.

**What You’ll Do**

**Podcast Media Planning \& Buying**

* Research podcasts, hosts, networks, and audiences to identify opportunities aligned with client goals.
* Request proposals, evaluate inventory, compare CPMs, and assist with negotiating rates and added value.
* Help plan and purchase host\-read ads, baked\-in placements, dynamically inserted ads, and podcast sponsorships.
* Coordinate insertion orders, talking points, promo codes, tracking links, creative approvals, and launch schedules.
* Verify ad placements, monitor delivery, and follow up with partners on reporting and makegoods.
* Maintain podcast buying trackers, partner contacts, budgets, and campaign calendars.

**Paid Social Campaign Management**

* Assist with building, launching, and managing campaigns in **Meta Ads Manager**, with opportunities to work across **TikTok Ads Manager** and other platforms.
* Set up campaign objectives, audiences, budgets, placements, and ad creative.
* Monitor spending, pacing, and performance; recommend and implement approved optimizations.
* Coordinate creative assets and copy, and help run tests across audiences, messaging, and formats.
* Support tracking setup and quality checks, including UTMs, pixels, and conversion events.
* Track metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, and ROAS, and translate results into actionable recommendations.

**Reporting \& Coordination**

* Keep media plans, campaign trackers, and reports accurate and up to date.
* Compile results across podcast and paid social campaigns into clear client updates.
* Communicate with media partners and internal collaborators to keep deliverables on schedule.
* Flag issues early and help improve planning, buying, and reporting processes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **1\+ years of experience** in media buying, media planning, paid social, or campaign management. Relevant internship experience may count.
* Hands\-on familiarity with **Meta Ads Manager**, including campaign setup, reporting, and basic optimization.
* An understanding of podcast advertising and an interest in developing podcast buying and negotiation skills.
* **Up to date on pop culture, current events, and internet culture**, with a pulse on trending creators, podcasts, memes, social conversation, and an instinct for what’s relevant to a brand’s audience.
* Comfort working with budgets, spreadsheets, and campaign performance metrics.
* Strong attention to detail, follow through, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* A willingness to ask questions, take initiative, and learn new platforms.
* Can think creatively and analytically.
* Is a self starter and isn’t scared to take initiative.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience buying podcast ads or coordinating with podcast networks and sales representatives.
* Experience with TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, or YouTube advertising.
* Familiarity with direct response campaigns, attribution, and conversion tracking.
* Experience coordinating host read scripts, creator partnerships, or sponsored content.
* An agency, publisher, or media company background.

**Why Camp Gravy**

* Work directly with the founder and receive hands on guidance.
* Build expertise as a marketing ninja.
* Contribute to campaign strategy, execution, and measurable client results.
* Take on more responsibility as your skills develop, with an anticipated path to full\-time employment as the business grows.
* Fun events, activations, and outings.

Pay: From $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90067

About Symtrax:

Symtrax is a global leader in providing innovative solutions that streamline business processes and enhance document management. \- Track the software market, our customers' needs and the competition

\- Coordinate with internal teams so campaign goals and messaging line up

\- At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing, including hands\-on Google Ads, lead nurturing and

SEO

\- Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data and metrics to make data\-driven decisions

\- Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively convey marketing messages

\- Proven experience in growing social media platforms and driving engagement

\- Experience with content creation and email marketing

\- WordPress, Adobe Creative Suite, Constant Contact or similar email marketing platform

\- Past experience with CRM/ERP software and report creation preferred

\- Comfortable working alongside AI drafting tools and in\-house software

\- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

jobs.title: B2B Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark with one of the biggest names in payments. At Global Payments, you help businesses grow by transforming how they accept and manage payments. As a B2B Outside Sales Representative on the Genius® team, you bring innovative solutions directly to business owners and create a real, measurable impact on their day\-to\-day operations.


You will join a team powered by energy, curiosity, and shared success. You will learn from experienced people leaders, build meaningful connections, and grow your career in a global business that is always evolving. Every conversation you lead and every relationship you build moves the future of commerce forward.


In this role, you’ll drive new business, shape client success and own outcomes that increase revenue, improve operations, and create long\-term value. You will lead the full sales cycle, influence decision\-making and bring the power of Genius® to life for businesses across your market.

**What you’ll own**

* Drive new business growth by creating opportunities through field outreach, digital engagement and local networking
* Own the full sales cycle, turning conversations into revenue and delivering consistent results in your territory
* Build trusted relationships with business owners, positioning yourself as a go\-to advisor who understands their goals
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven presentations that show how Genius® improves operations, increases loyalty and fuels growth
* Shape your territory strategy using market insights, strengthening your pipeline and accelerating deal momentum
* Expand Global Payments’ impact by introducing innovative solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow faster
* Strengthen long\-term client value by identifying opportunities to expand solutions and deepen relationships
* Spend up to 75% of your time in the field, creating meaningful, face\-to\-face connections that drive results

**What you bring**

* At least one year of success in B2B or business\-to\-consumer (B2C) outside sales, with a track record of delivering results
* Strong ability to communicate, present and negotiate, both in person and virtually
* Confidence building relationships quickly and earning trust with business owners
* A competitive, self\-driven mindset with the energy to achieve and exceed goals
* Ability to think like a client and connect solutions to real business outcomes
* Valid driver’s license and comfort spending up to 75% of your time in the field
* Residence within two hours of the territory to stay connected and responsive

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* A proven ability to upsell and cross\-sell existing merchants on new features, software add\-ons, and hardware upgrades.
* Experience working with the restaurant or retail industries is a plus.
* Two full years of B2B Outside Sales experience, preferably in fintech, merchant services or Saas.

**Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you**


We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.  

* A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
* Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
* Access to learning, development and on\-the\-job experiences that expand your expertise
* A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
* Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
* A global employee assistance program to support your wellbeing
* Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements.

https://jobs.globalpayments.com/en/why\-global\-payments/benefits/

 **What makes a Globalpayer?**


Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

**Benefits**


Global Payments offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement programs, charitable gift matching, and more. Learn more at Global Payments Benefits.


Diversity and EEO Statements


Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.


Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. Global Payments provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by law. **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned territory including but not limited to customer sites, healthcare facilities, and business meetings.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in outside sales, field sales, business development, account management, customer success, territory management, or a customer\-facing role.
* Experience managing responsibilities through work experience, athletics, academic programs, military service, or leadership activities.
* Exposure to medical device, healthcare, clinical, life sciences, business\-to\-business sales, or other performance\-driven environments.

At Stryker, you’ll be part of a collaborative, high\-performing team focused on making an impact for our customers and patients. We offer a dynamic environment with strong opportunities for growth and long\-term career development within a global leader in medical technology.

 $80,500 salary and may be eligible to earn a bonus \+ benefits

Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. jobs.description:
Overview:
**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**  

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top\-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award\-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.  

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high\-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.  

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.  

With Orkin’s award\-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.  

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**  


Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.
**You will…*** Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in\-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…*** **Estimated first\-year earnings: $60,000 \- $120,000 USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, \& life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?*** You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession\-resistant industry
* You have a service\-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission\-driven company that values**
	+ *Safety*
	+ *Professionalism*
	+ *Empathy*
	+ *Integrity*
	+ *Innovation*


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**
Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity

jobs.title: Business Development Representative West Coast
jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the West Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the West Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the West Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the West Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Hospitality experience required
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles
* AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands\-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result


**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**



Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.



This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.



If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process \- your recruiter will be able to help.


#### **What's in it for you?**



Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.


#### **Global benefits**



No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:


* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work\-from\-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**



You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

* Support the Executive Director in advancing organizational priorities by coordinating tasks, deadlines, follow\-up, and cross\-functional commitments; proactively flagging outstanding items, competing priorities, and time\-sensitive needs.
* Serve as the administrative backbone for executive\-level collaboratives including scheduling, onboarding, offboarding, participation tracking, capturing meeting minutes, and action items.

Qualifications* Bachelors Degree, required.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Executive Assistant

**Reports to:** CEO

**Education Preferred (Not Required):** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education and experience

**Experience Required:** Minimum of 3 years of administration or related experience (non\-profit experience preferred)

**Position is:** Non\-Exempt, Full Time (30\-38 hours/week)

**Salary Range:** $25\.00 \- $28\.00/hr.

**About Families Forward**

At Families Forward, we are dedicated to preventing and ending family homelessness and strengthening community wellbeing across Orange County. Since 1984, our nonprofit organization has provided compassionate support that empowers families to achieve lasting stability and self\-sufficiency through housing programs, essential services like our food pantry and career counseling, and meaningful resources that nurture resilience and hope. Guided by our core values of dignity, empowerment, accountability, community spirit, and hope, we strive to create an environment where families can thrive and where every team member feels inspired, valued, and equipped to make a meaningful impact in the lives of others. We believe in fostering a collaborative and inclusive workplace where passion for service meets purpose\-driven work. Join us in building stronger families and a stronger community.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and compassionate Executive Assistant to support the CEO and leadership team. This role is essential in helping the organization operate efficiently and strategically at the executive level. This role requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and a passion for supporting mission\-driven work. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to the values of our organization. This position plays a central role in facilitating smooth operations, effective internal communication, and a positive workplace culture.

**Essential Job Duties:**

**CEO and Executive Leadership Support (45% of time spent):**

* Provide direct administrative support to the CEO, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating travel.
* Provide administrative support to the Executive Leadership team as needed, including scheduling calendars and project coordination, document preparation, and logistics for strategic initiatives.
* Assist with maintaining agency\-wide organizational calendars and timelines for events, reports, and meetings.
* Prepare and edit correspondence, presentations, board materials, and internal documents.
* Support CEO in donor stewardship and development activities, including event coordination and tracking communications.
* Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate cultural humility when working with sensitive information related to clients and operations.
* Conduct research and support strategic initiatives at the request of the CEO.

**Board Administration (30% of time spent):**

* Primary interface with the Board of Directors.
* Coordinate logistics for board of directors and committee meetings: prepare agendas, compile meeting packets, set\-up meetings, take minutes, and track follow\-up actions.
* Maintain Board rosters and attendance.
* Facilitate the Board orientations and new member manuals.
* Support Board of Directors special events.
* Organize and maintain board related files and records in SharePoint.

**Admin and HR Support (15% of time spent):**

* Support with administrative tasks and functions including opening daily mail, managing Families Forward info email inbox, assisting with managing all staff directory/phone lists, and more.
* Support HR functions as needed, including scheduling interviews and coordinating onboarding logistics for new staff.
* Assist with processing invoices, check requests, and coding expense reimbursements in coordination with the Finance team.
* Track receipts and reconcile credit card transactions for the CEO and executive leadership team.
* Assist with tracking and updating organizational policies, procedures, and administrative documents.

**Employee Engagement Support (10% of time spent):**

* Help plan and coordinate all\-staff meetings, retreats, appreciation events, and wellness initiatives.
* Support efforts to foster a strong, inclusive organizational culture by gathering staff feedback, assisting with engagement surveys, and helping implement morale\-boosting activities.
* Serve as a trusted partner to staff across departments to promote collaboration and ensure clear communication between leadership and team members.

Special Projects/Other Duties as Assigned

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Exceptional communication, writing, and editing skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Zoom, and project management tools.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and handle sensitive information with integrity.
* Deep commitment to the mission of ending homelessness and supporting underserved populations.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships.
* Exercise good judgement in a variety of situations.
* Flexible hours for early meetings as well as occasional responsibilities on the weekends or in the evening.
* Ability to occasionally lift or carry 25 pounds.
* Valid California Driver License and State Mandated Vehicle Insurance.

**What You Need to Be Successful in This Role**

* You stay a step ahead of the CEO and leadership team by anticipating needs, managing details, and keeping schedules, meetings, documents, travel, and follow\-up items moving smoothly.
* You bring order to complexity by balancing competing priorities, tracking deadlines, and making sure important tasks, decisions, and communications do not fall through the cracks.
* You communicate with clarity, professionalism, and warmth whether you are preparing materials, drafting correspondence, coordinating with staff, or serving as a point of contact for board members and extern

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Construction Project Coordinator oversees the defining scope, planning, implementation, tracking and completion/evaluation of projects which have a beginning, an end and specified deliverables. Must be able to reconcile construction activities and manage scope change during project and complete project within designated time frame and on budget.

Construction Project Coordinator must take ownership of projects they are assigned.

**Job Duties/Responsibilities:**

1\. Hit Target Revenue provided

2\. Contacting customers for projects once the pre\-construction phase is complete.

3\. Customer point of contact for on\-site activities

4\. Responsible for overall project success – being on time and under budget

5\. Responsible for managing and delegating to Project Coordinator Assistants as needed

6\. During construction phase, track and coordinate materials, schedule, timelines and budget and if necessary RFI log

7\. Manage sub\-contractors on current projects for construction activities

8\. Schedule projects with all subcontractors and customers.

a. To do so, three things must be accomplished, in order:

i. Design drawings must be completed and approved by client

ii. Materials from vendors must have delivery date finalized

iii. Confirmation in writing from the client that onsite date is acceptable

9\. Coordinating with Design Department to obtain all the necessary documentation for projects during construction phase

10\. Provide regular updates to Management as requested

11\. Responsible for receiving and inventory of the material as the first step of construction phase. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required.

12\. Control Job Tickets and what is in job tickets

13\. Coordinating with Project Coordinator Assistants as to Field Tech availability and forecasting field techs to projects

14\. Create Hot Sheets for items that need to be addressed once the main body of work is completed and there are still minor things to complete

15\. Travel to jobsite or offsite coordination meetings as required with Operations Manager, Supervisor, or Foreman

16\. First day of work walk the job site with field techs and Field Tech Manager or Foreman

17\. Assist with Pickups/Deliveries if required

18\. Other responsibilities and tasks as assigned or needed

19\. Responsible for creating and submitting Change Orders/Credit Memos during construction phase:

a. If client is requesting a change in scope, addition, or alternative solution

b. If on site conditions are not as specified in the project’s documentation

i. If questions arise from any of the above, report to Operations Manager for direction

ii. Change orders are to be submitted to Operations Manager for review/comment/approval

20\. Update clients daily for work completed that day and anticipated completion date for the rest of the work

21\. Responsible to maintain daily logs for onsite work

22\. Responsible for Forecasting all projects during the weekly forecasting meeting held Tuesdays

23\. Coordinating, setting up, and preparing for Weekly Huddles

24\. Assist in closing of city permits \- schedule final inspections with city department

25\. Responsible for closeouts of the project with closeout docs completed such as test reports, As\-built, OPOS, warranties, O\&M, MSDS sheets, project manuals, AI reports etc.

26\. Responsible for keeping project status updated on project management software

27\. Responsible for sending the weekly billing to pre\-construction project coordinator for ongoing projects

28\. Coordinate project coordinator visits (PCV) requests from design team

29\. Hold closeout documents meeting on Thursdays

30\. Responsible for responding to clients within 24 hours

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma (College or Business school desirable)
* A minimum of 2\-5 years of experience in construction project management.
* Direct experience in construction field operations, including site visits and supervision, is highly beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines.
* Proficiency in construction management software, scheduling tools, and project management software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with clients, contractors, and team members.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues promptly and efficiently.

**Physical Requirements**

This is primarily a sedentary office position, which requires the ability to occasionally bend, stoop, reach, lift, move and carry supplies and materials up to 40 lbs.

May also be required to physically attend off\-site meetings, gather site\-specific information and observations, and travel to multiple project locations.

**Qualification Requirements**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $26\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* This role is a fully in\-office position that requires occasional travel to construction project sites for site visits, which may involve navigating active construction environments, climbing stairs or ladders, and walking project sites. Are you able to perform these essential job functions with or without a reasonable accommodation?
* This position requires proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word) and the ability to quickly learn specialized construction software like S

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  

  

**Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

  

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.description:
We are so glad you are interested in joining Sutter Health!

**Organization:**


SPMF\-Sutter Pacific Medical Foundation \- South**Position Overview:**


Responsible for providing administrative logistics and operations support to a clinical or non\-clinical program. Serves as principal administrative contact and liaison for internal and external department or program constituencies. Duties may include program implementation and administration support, internal and external operational/administrative liaison, program marketing support, and reporting. Works within established procedures with a moderate degree of supervision in a work environment of multiple and conflicting priorities; recognized and solves typical program problems and updates program manager/leader on status of projects.**Job Description**:

*These Principal Accountabilities, Requirements and Qualifications are not exhaustive, but are merely the most descriptive of the current job. Management reserves the right to revise the job description or require that other tasks be performed when the circumstances of the job change (for example, emergencies, staff changes, workload, or technical development).*  

  

**JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

  

PROGRAM SUPPORT:  

* Handles day\-to\-day logistics and administrative activities between units to ensure optimal program operations.
* Performs clerical and administrative support tasks, including creation, typing, and editing of program correspondence, purchasing documents, reports, program handbooks, and other publications.
* Creates, edits, and coordinates development of program materials including: promotional materials, educational materials, training manuals, newsletters, and/or brochures, as appropriate to the program.
* Performs specialized activities of a programmatic nature in direct support of the accomplishment of program objectives and protocol.
* Collects and compiles data; prepares scheduled and special reports; maintains program records and statistical information.
* Performs information management functions, including maintaining databases, entering and auditing data, and preparing routine and/or ad\-hoc reports on behalf of the program.
  

CUSTOMER SERVICE:  

* Serves as administrative program liaison and contact for patients, visitors, staff, other departments, external agencies and regulatory bodies as appropriate.
* Researches issues; interact with other departments, physicians or administrators as needed; resolves or escalates issues when appropriate.
* Receives and screens calls, messages, mail and email communications, and visitors. Refers and answers inquiries as appropriate procedures and policies relating to departmental functions.
  

FINANCIAL RESPONSABILITIES:  

* Monitors budget(s) including grants, maintains financial documentation, provides information, research, statistics, and analysis.
* Monitors program/project revenues and expenses; may develop or participate in the development of funding proposals for the program.
* Processes invoice and check requests according with established policies and procedures.
  

SAFETY:  

* Maintains a clean, neat, and safe working environment, by inventorying and ordering accessories and supplies periodically to maintain established stock levels.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Specialist (Middle School Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach)**

**Salary:****$26\-$30 per hour, plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator**

**Status:****Full Time (30 hours/week); Non\-Exempt (Position ends 6/2/2027\)**

 **POSITION DESCRIPTION**


Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist (Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach) is responsible for providing academic tutoring, educational support and behavioral coaching to youth during the school day and in after school programs. The position is responsible for tutoring middle school aged students in core academic classes such as English, Math, Science, Social Studies, etc. The position may also support a variety of enrichment activities as needed.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide one\-on\-one and group academic tutoring in core subject areas and behavioral coaching to students.
* Collaborate and coordinate with school day teachers, counselors, and beacon staff to identify high needs students who need educational support.
* Provide 1:1 light case management to students who need social emotional learning and behavioral health support.
* Provide training and support to high school volunteer tutors as needed.
* Create incentive plans to encourage student engagement and retention.
* Develop and support a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for youth as needed.
* Support with outreach and marketing strategies to recruit and retain youth programs.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Work collaboratively with the school leadership team, community partners, and faculty to design and align programs to support the school’s goals for student development, academic achievement, social and emotional learning.
* Make contact with parents/caregivers in a professional and consistent manner to advise parents on youths' progress and challenges.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested by funders and supervisor.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields preferred plus 2 years of proven experience in youth development or experience in providing academic support.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with diverse youth and families is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills (both oral and written).
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multi\-task, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs \& sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Cantonese/Mandarin, or Arabic is a plus.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

  

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cancer Immunotherapy Research & Clinical Translation Program
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join the Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation (CIRCT) Program within the Division of Hematology/Oncology.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager and/or the Principal Investigator (PI). The incumbent will coordinate the operations and data collection of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies (sponsored, cooperative group, and investigator\-initiated studies), depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; assist with training of Assistant CRCs help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; assist in maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.  

  



**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is a national leader in oncology research. The Cancer Immunotherapy Research \& Clinical Translation program is a fast paced program with a broad portfolio of clinical trials. The mission of the UCSF HDFCC Oncology Program is to provide patients and their families with streamlined access to cutting\-edge cancer therapies, In addition to providing compassionate, patient\-centered care, our team of clinicians and researchers is dedicated to improving outcomes for all patients.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Familiarity with specimen processing, or demonstrated ability to learn specimen processing in a laboratory environment
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Ability to work across several different programs, reporting to 2\-3 different supervisors
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences.
* Exceptional database management experience and prior experience with various computer programs (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore.
* Experience with medical charts and electronic records
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day. May need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle. Ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of, or demonstrated ability to learn federal, state, and local research regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team oriented environment

Preferred Qualifications:


* Bachelor's degree with a major in science or related
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials and experience with Phase I\-III trials
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:



	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

jobs.description:
The Health Education Program Coordinator manages and implements health education programs, develops community education and outreach activities, and counsels patients.

* Develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates bilingual health education programs and activities on preventative health care, chronic disease management, Western medicine, and other related topics
* Develops curricula, toolkits, health education programs and materials
* Provides group class and/or one\-on\-one health education services to members and the general public
* Acts as primary liaison with appropriate community agencies and schools to establish, promote, and carry out community education and outreach programs
* Manages Health Education centers
* Counsels patients on a variety of subjects such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, smoking cessation, substance abuse, teen health, Hepatitis B, preventive cancer screening and immunization, etc.
* Coordinates with clinical departments to develop multilingual educational material
* Reviews translations of materials for accuracy and appropriateness
* Researches grants and funding opportunities, and assists in writing grant proposals
* Collects, tabulates, analyzes program data, and prepares reports
* Works collaboratively with Administration and Project Management Department, and provides support in health information projects such as activity schedule, newsletter, informational displays, flyers posters, staff bulletin, community health events, etc.
* Travels to NEMS’ clinic site to conduct programs and events
* Supervises summer interns and volunteers and assists in implementing education activities for the Health Center Week
* Provides day\-to\-day operational support to Health Education Assistants including scheduling, training, and guidance; acts as a liaison to communicate updates or concerns to Health Education Manager as needed
* Supports walk\-ins and provider referrals to Health Education
* Administers Remote Patient Monitoring assignment, monitoring, tracking and calls
* Calls outreach lists tied to organizational goals and PIP measures, as needed
* Assists with ad hoc outreach lists (e.g., health plan initiatives or incentive programs that require patient outreach), as needed
* Covers and rotates to other sites as required
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor




**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree (degree in public health or related field preferred).
* Health \& Wellness Coach Training completed by a NBC\-HWC\-approved program or ability to obtain it within 6 months of first available training date is required
* CHES certification preferred
* Two years’ experience in community health education, health communication or related field preferred
* Prior experience in program planning, design and implementation that incorporates evidence\-based strategies and cultural competency
* Experience with formative research or program evaluation preferred
* Prior experience working with the underserved, immigrant, low\-income and/or Asian communities preferred
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required

* Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Must be fluent in Chinese: Cantonese and/or Mandarin (reading, writing, and speaking)

This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.
