We are looking for a friendly, outgoing, Japanese\-speaking team member to help us create food, cultural, fandom, gaming, and entertainment experiences in the Bay Area.

This is a hands\-on role that combines Japanese community and brand relationships, event coordination, hosting, food, games, fandom, and social media.

You will help communicate with Japanese brands and partners, coordinate community and fandom events, work with vendors and collaborators, interact with guests, and represent our company both in person and online.

Professional event or marketing experience is not required. We are especially interested in people who are personable, reliable, curious, and excited to learn.

This could be a great fit for someone looking for flexible part\-time work, including parents, semi\-retired professionals, students, freelancers, or people pursuing other creative projects.

What You’ll Do

Japanese Community \& Brand Relationships

* Communicate with Japanese\-speaking brands, businesses, restaurants, food companies, creators, and cultural organizations
* Help build and maintain relationships with Japanese brands and partners both locally and internationally
* Communicate with partners in Japanese through email, messaging, and other channels
* Assist with outreach to potential vendors, sponsors, collaborators, and brand partners
* Coordinate product samples, brand activations, collaborations, and other partnership details
* Research interesting Japanese brands, products, trends, and potential collaborations

Events \& Community Programming

Required Qualifications

* Fluent spoken Japanese
* Strong Japanese reading and writing ability
* Able to communicate comfortably in English
* Friendly, approachable, and comfortable talking with new people

* Reliable and responsible
* Willing to learn and take initiative
* Comfortable with hands\-on event work and changing priorities

Experience \& Skills

* Hosting, theater, performance, presenting, or public speaking

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Golden State Dermatology is a physician\-led and owned dermatology group rapidly expanding across California. We are a leading medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology group specializing in skin, hair, and nail conditions, Mohs micrographic surgery for the treatment of skin cancer, surgical and non\-surgical cosmetic skincare, anti\-aging, body contouring, and plastic surgery.

  

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the conduct of clinical trials under the direction of the Principal Investigator and research leadership. This position is responsible for coordinating assigned studies and ensuring study activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with study protocols, ICH\-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and institutional requirements.

  

The Coordinator works closely with study participants, investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other research staff. Responsibilities include study start\-up and regulatory activities, participant recruitment and study visits, source documentation and EDC entry, safety reporting, study supply management, monitoring visit preparation, and study close\-out.

* Obtain and document informed consent when appropriately delegated by the Principal Investigator.

* Protect participant rights, safety, privacy, and confidentiality.
* Document protocol deviations and assist with required follow\-up and corrective actions.

* Enter study data into electronic data capture (EDC) systems within required timelines.
* Review study data and documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Respond to and resolve data queries promptly.
* Maintain organized study files and documentation suitable for sponsor monitoring and regulatory review.

 **Safety \& Quality**

* Prepare study records and materials for monitoring visits.

For more than 50 years, Digital Power has provided standard and custom power solutions to global customers across the defense and aerospace, medical and healthcare, telecommunications, industrial, and OEM markets. Digital Power works closely with customers and partners to engineer advanced power solutions focused on customization, performance, and reliability. Digital Power is headquartered in San Jose, California.

* Research approved target accounts, applications, programs, and buying contacts using ZoomInfo, CRM data, public sources, and internal information.
* Build and maintain target\-account and contact lists across OEMs, integrators, primes, distributors, manufacturer representatives, and past customers.
* Execute personalized outreach by email, phone, and approved social channels; qualify interest and schedule discovery, customer, rep, and executive meetings.

* Prepare concise account and meeting briefs; capture meaningful meetings; track open quote follow\-up and coordinate with the formal NetSuite quote/order process.
* Support manufacturer rep groups with contact records, joint target lists, activity tracking, training coordination, and scheduled check\-ins.
* Coordinate customer visits, travel, trade\-show appointments, materials, and post\-event follow\-up so meaningful activity results in a clear next step.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**


You will help create more qualified customer conversations while making DPC easier to work with internally. Success is measured by meeting quality, sales\-accepted opportunities, target and contact coverage, complete CRM records, timely follow\-through, rep engagement, and strong preparation for customer visits and events—not simply raw activity volume.


Early focus includes clean target and contact coverage, qualified meetings accepted by senior sales, accurate CRM records with no stale next steps, timely quote follow\-up, prepared meetings, and closed\-loop post\-event activity.


You will report directly to the National Director of Sales and Business Development, and work closely with senior sales, engineering, marketing, and manufacturer representative partners. Your focus is to create qualified access and reliable commercial execution so experienced sellers can focus on strategic accounts and complex opportunities.

 **Requirements**  

* Two or more years of experience in sales development, business development, sales operations, account coordination, customer success, or another B2B customer\-facing role.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills and comfort initiating outreach to new contacts.
* Experience working in a CRM and strong attention to detail when managing account information, activity records, tasks, and follow\-up.
* Ability to research companies and contacts, organize multiple priorities, and bring practical judgment to when a customer response should be escalated.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace and comfort learning sales\-research and CRM tools. Experience with ZoomInfo, HubSpot, NetSuite, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools is a plus.
* Technical B2B, manufacturing, industrial, defense, medical, telecommunications, or power\-electronics experience is helpful, but not required.
* Ability to work from our San Jose, California location and travel occasionally for customer visits or industry events when needed.

  

**Benefits**  

* Compensation: Digital Power offers a competitive total compensation package consisting of a base salary plus performance\-based sales incentive commissions/bonuses. Final determination depends on experience, technical qualifications, and territory scope.
* Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; 401(k) retirement plan with company match; paid time off (PTO) and holidays; and applicable leave programs.


TurnOnGreen, Inc. and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive workforce.

jobs.description:
**Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology**


At **Tarana**, we're more than just a fast\-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering **fiber\-class internet speeds** worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible.

**Why Tarana**


Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, reliable, and affordable internet access around the world, fueling healthy competition in established markets and closing the digital divide wherever it persists. Our next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) platform delivers fiber\-class broadband at a fraction of the cost and deployment time of traditional options, and is already available to more than 20M homes and businesses globally.


That mission comes to life at industry events, where our prospects and customers get to hear from our team and see the technology firsthand. We're looking for someone to lead that experience end to end.


We need a highly organized **Event Marketing Manager** to help define our strategy behind tradeshow and conference sponsorships, own logistics and implementation from beginning to end, and play a key role in producing our self\-hosted events — both in person and virtual/hybrid. This person will also partner with the broader marketing team to ensure our event strategy reflects team goals and current campaign initiatives, leads are delivered to sales and analyzed for event fit, and more.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Strategically manage our event portfolio, align the events with business goals and target accounts, lead the event initiatives and be accountable for the outcomes.
* Recommend on a regular basis to Sales and Marketing leadership ways to improve event strategy and execution.
* Oversee the annual calendar of events — 60\-70 shows per year of varying size/scope — to stay on top of deadlines, often times for multiple shows at once
* Plan and implement booth layouts (swag orders, table displays, display equipment, furniture and service rentals, etc.)
* Negotiate show contracts, manage vendor relationships and supervise vendor and industry partner collaboration as well as event execution
* Handle all shipping \& handling of event materials to ensure smooth set up and take down
* Build an annual budget plan, Reforecast throughout the year and conduct ROI analysis for tradeshow and conference sponsorships to ensure that our spend aligns with our target audiences and company goals
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with Tarana Sales and other internal teams that our support events
* Submit purchase requisitions and ensure vendor invoices are paid in a timely manner, recording and tracking expenses for each event
* Assist with planning and on\-site production for Tarana\-hosted events \- Spanning agenda coordination, speaker/session logistics, registration platforms, and attendee experience
* Manage promotions via website, email, social media, and other advertising
* Travel to support events when necessary (roughly 4 times per year)
* Office presence required: at least three days per week

 **What You'll Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field
* 5\-7 years of experience in event planning, field marketing, tradeshow coordination, or similar field \- ideally in a B2B or technology environment
* Excellent organization and thorough project management, even under a time crunch
* Ability to roll with punches and excel in a fast\-paced environment
* Collaboration and superb communication, both written and verbal
* Diligent budget management and ROI analysis
* Solid understanding of social media (primarily LinkedIn, and also Facebook, X, Instagram and YouTube)

 **Bonus Points for****:**

* Graphic design experience
* Experience with Asana tool
* Telecom and broadband industry knowledge

 **What we offer:**  

**We don’t just build next\-gen wireless technology — we build people.**


 The salary range for this position is: $105,000 to $125,000


Compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to: skill set, years of experience and the employee’s geographic location.


Tarana provides competitive benefits to employees in this role, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401K match, flexible time off, and stock options.  

  

**Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity**.

**About Us**


Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R\&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game\-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com.

### **About Us**



Hively has been serving Alameda County families since 1976\. We support families through child care stipends and referrals, family resource navigation, parent education classes, and clinical mental health services. Our mission is to create meaningful connections with families and communities, ensuring access to resources every child in Alameda County needs to thrive. Our vision is to transform the lives of children and families to benefit all communities and ensure a promising future for generations to come.



If this resonates with you, we invite you to apply to join our team!



Hively’s presence around Alameda County is growing. Our Hive on Wheels (Mobile Resource Center) and tabling events accounted for more than 120 events in the last fiscal year. Our Marketing, Communications and Development Team is ready to welcome a new team member to support our outreach, community engagement and communications efforts


### **Position Overview**



Are you passionate about making a difference in your community, connecting with people, building relationships and creating welcoming spaces for families and child care providers? This role is part of our Marketing, Communications and Development team. It’s mainly an external facing role to represent Hively at community events, supporting the Hive on Wheels program, and community engagement work. In this role, you'll be the friendly face of Hively, being an active part of our community events that are engaging, well\-organized, and welcoming for families, children and other community stakeholders.


**Please note that many of our events occur in the evenings and/or on weekends, so the schedule for this role will often vary, with work frequently performed outside of normal business hours (flex hours are planned).**

  



### **What You'll Do**


* **Coordinate Event Logistics:** Manage all aspects of Hive on Wheels and tabling events, from liaising with host organizations to promoting events and handling pre\- and post\-event checklists.
* **Research and secure events across Alameda county:** Find mission aligned events that will allow us to meet outreach and community engagement goals.
* **Manage Supplies:** Ensure the van is fully stocked with essential consumables (diapers, clothing, print materials). You'll also be responsible for packing up and recharging electronics after each event.
* **Setup and Breakdown:** Efficiently set up and take down all event materials, displays, and activities.
* **Engage with the Community:** Greet families, collect survey responses, distribute materials, and answer questions about Hively's services with warmth and professionalism.
* **Facilitate Activities:** Lead or assist with fun, kid\-friendly activities. Be our Hively Bee Mascot when needed.
* **Build Relationships:** Proactively identify and connect with community leaders and partners at events, and share introductions with senior leadership following events.
* **Capture and Share Content:** Take photos and videos at events and post to social media following our guidelines.
* **Support Reporting:** Assist with post\-event reporting, including data entry, creating quantitative reports, and sharing qualitative stories from events.
* **Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders:** Work closely with Hively staff, volunteers, and partner organizations.
* **Communications Support (20%):** Assist with a variety of organizational needs including WordPress updates, Canva designs, printing, swag orders and more.
* **Online Outreach (10%):** Update and maintain online platforms such as: Facebook groups, Instagram and other platforms.
### **What You'll Bring**


* **A Passion for Community:** You have an interest in community engagement, social services, or early childhood education.
* **Previous Experience:** 2\+ years of work experience in event planning and execution, community engagement, communications or marketing. Experience working with children is also a plus.
* **Excellent Communication Skills:** You're comfortable talking to people and building rapport quickly.
* **Highly Organized:** You're dependable and detail\-oriented with an eye for design aesthetic; you are able to manage multiple tasks at once.
* **Flexibility and Adaptability:** You're comfortable working in a mobile, outdoor setting with a variable schedule.
* **Physical Requirements:** You're able to lift up to 30 lbs and assist with event setup and breakdown.
* **Driving Experience:** You have a valid driver’s license, a clean driving record, and are comfortable driving a 22\-foot Ford Transit Van.
* **Bilingual Skills (Spanish):** **Spanish proficiency is required.**
* **Experience with Children:** You enjoy working with children and are willing to serve as the Hively Bee Mascot would be a plus.

### **What you will learn:**


* Event planning and coordination
* Community outreach and engagement strategies
* Exposure to early childhood and family support services
* Networking with local partners
* WordPress, Canva, HubSpot and other design and marketing tools.

jobs.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

### **About the Role**


As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest\-velocity, highest\-volume post\-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands\-on customer impact \- driving excellence in post\-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast\-moving book of accounts.


This is a revenue\-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first \- more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

**You will:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high\-volume book of business.
* Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate \- building a team culture where expansions and cross\-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota\-carrying sales function.
* Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
* Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
* Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI\-powered approaches to their work.
* Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
* Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post\-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high\-volume, transactional or corporate\-segment books of business.
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
* 2\+ years of direct people leadership experience \- managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high\-performance, feedback\-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
* Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
* Strong player\-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
* Expertise in post\-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high\-volume, scaled motion.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Manager 2, Data Science - Intuit Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


The Intuit Customer Success (ICS) Data Science \& Analytics team is seeking an exceptional Manager 2, Data Science to lead measurement of expert\-driven service excellence across our CG expert workforce. You will lead a team of data scientists covering five interlocking areas: expert\-driven conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities (work item management, scheduling, and appointments), training efficacy and expert upskilling strategy, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization across our Team of Experts.

  

Collaborating closely with VEP (Virtual Expert Platform), Expert Network, and Service Design leaders, you will build the measurement backbone needed to see and optimize service excellence end\-to\-end (E2E) at scale for CG — with a particular focus on conversion and customer\-serving time outcomes. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of customer success at Intuit as we build a service platform to empower our customers beyond core product use. This is your opportunity to join this exciting and transformational journey.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own the measurement strategy across CG's expert service pillars — expert experiences conversion initiatives, VEP operational capabilities, training and upskilling, expert quality and service\-guidance adherence, and labor optimization — in close partnership with VEP, Expert Network, and Service Design leaders.
* Advance causal inference and experimentation as a shared capability, establishing the causal relationship between service guidance, expert behavior, and outcomes like conversion and customer\-serving time.
* Contribute to a cross\-signal, causal\-graph decision engine that connects expert behavior, quality, and operational signals to size the impact of levers and inform roadmap and investment decisions.
* Build and govern the training and learning platform efficacy framework, connecting L\&D investment to expert quality and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional business leaders (e.g., VEP, Expert Network, Service Design, Service Delivery, Operations, Learning \& Development, Expert Engagement) to shape strategy, investment priorities, and reporting cadence (e.g., WBR, Redzone).
* Lead and develop a world\-class team of analysts and data scientists, coaching technical and strategic skill sets, especially in advanced analytics, applied data science, and modeling.
* Translate business and analytics strategies into multiple short\-term and long\-term projects, and manage end\-to\-end execution, including the creation of a metric framework for expert experiences and developing learning plans that connect training and service investments to expert experience metrics.
* Activate analytics insights that lead to decisions or better hypotheses, and evangelize innovative analytics ideas that enable new opportunities.
* Drive analytics rigor by inspecting and improving experimentation methodologies and techniques, and creating a learning culture.
* Drive the data roadmap from data quality to data visualization, and construct data models that enable E2E service excellence measurement.
* Role\-model "win\-together" while challenging the status quo and driving change across teams, regardless of organizational structure.

 **Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of diverse analytics and data science experience, including product analytics and customer/expert experience analytics.
* Proven experience leading a team of analysts and/or scientists.
* Strong passion for uncovering strategic opportunities and solving business problems.
* Prior hands\-on experience with advanced statistical analysis, controlled experimentation (including A/B testing of hierarchical mixed effects), and applied data science.
* Prior hands\-on experience with Causal Inference methods (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control, etc.) and knowing when to use them to answer key business questions.
* Experience designing quality and experience metrics (e.g., NPS\-style scores, quality scorecards) and connecting them to business KPIs such as conversion and service time.
* Proficient with SQL and Python.
* Experience applying AI/ML and GenAI tools to accelerate analysis and workflows.
* Experience with data gap assessments, requirements gathering, and infrastructure implementation.
* Outstanding communication skills with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, etc.)

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

San Diego $189,000 \- $256,000

jobs.description:
Haines (haines.com) is a vital San Francisco art gallery known for its compelling exhibitions and roster of international artists. Haines is seeking a talented, Bay Area\-based Social Media and Community Manager to foster visibility and engagement via its social channels.

The Social Media and Community Manager is an hourly\-based, contractor position requiring approximately 8\-10 hours / week, including weekly Zoom meetings. Exact hours will fluctuate depending on gallery activity and needs. Much of the work can be done remotely, but the Social Media and Community Manager is expected to attend and capture relevant gallery / art events, as well as traveling to gallery / artists studios to shoot videos.

Salary: $30\-35 per hour, depending on experience.

**Social Handles**  
IG:  
FB:  
LinkedIn (less active):

**SCOPE OF WORK**

**Strategy and Campaign Development**  
Plan and carry out social media campaigns around Haines Gallery’s exhibitions, artists, events, and other priorities, with the goal of increasing visibility and engagement.

**Content Creation and Publishing**  
Produce, edit, schedule, and publish engaging, platform\-native content across the gallery’s active social channels, primarily Instagram and Facebook, maintaining a consistent posting cadence across all active platforms. Content should include compelling short\-form video, such as Reels featuring artists, studio visits, and exhibition walk\-throughs, as well as other original content. Develop a mix of timely and evergreen content to sustain engagement when needed.

Maintain a thoughtful, informed voice consistent with the gallery’s identity, with particular attention to accuracy in references to artists, artworks, and exhibitions. Assess opportunities to expand Haines Gallery’s presence on TikTok and other emerging platforms.

**Community Engagement and Audience Growth**  
Actively engage with Haines Gallery’s audiences and the broader Bay Area and international art communities, identifying opportunities for partnership, cross\-promotion, and audience growth. Cultivate engaged members of the gallery’s network who can help amplify exhibitions, artists, and programs.

Look for opportunities to reshare audience and partner content, and use platform features such as collaborative posts and event listings where they can help extend reach. Develop sharing kits when useful and encourage artists, institutions, and other participants to amplify campaigns through their own channels.

Respond to comments and messages, forwarding sales\-related inquiries to gallery staff for follow\-up.

**Social Listening and Content Curation**  
Rather than treating Haines Gallery’s accounts as a one\-way broadcast channel, stay attuned to what is happening online around the gallery, its artists, and the broader art community. Use social listening tools to monitor artists’ accounts, partner organizations, cultural conversations, and other relevant social channels to identify exhibition coverage, user\-generated content, and opportunities for engagement. Curate appropriate external content for resharing, including relevant arts\-related content beyond the gallery’s own artists and exhibitions.

**Analytics and Reporting**  
Track social media performance across platforms, including audience growth, engagement, reach, and campaign effectiveness. Prepare and present periodic reports on key trends and insights, and make recommendations to gallery leadership to refine strategy and improve campaign performance.

**ABOUT YOU**

Successful candidates will have experience using Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Hootsuite, or comparable tools for content creation, scheduling, and social media management. The ability to produce engaging video content is essential, as are strong organizational, writing, and communication skills. Candidates should be responsive to direction while also being comfortable working independently. Experience managing social media and community engagement in the visual arts is preferred.

**Please send resume, cover letter, and work samples to David Spalding at david@hainesgallery.com by September 20, 2026\. No phone inquiries. Selected candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.**

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

* Flexible schedule

* Social media management: 1 year (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* San Francisco, CA 94123 (Required)

Abaka AI is built on one mission: to be the world's most trusted data partner for AI companies. More than 1,000 industry leaders across Generative AI, Embodied AI, and Automotive AI rely on us to power their data pipelines. With our headquarters in Silicon Valley—and teams in Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo—we support global partners with fast, reliable, and scalable data solutions.
Our offerings include a diverse catalog of off\-the\-shelf datasets—including image, video, multimodal, reasoning, and 3D data—as well as comprehensive data collection and annotation services. Whether teams need raw data, curated datasets, or full\-cycle data engineering, Abaka AI provides the foundation for building high\-performance AI systems.

**About the Role**
As the Social Media Manager, you'll have the opportunity to craft and execute social strategies for Abaka AI across X, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
Your main responsibilities will involve writing social media content and articles, scheduling posts, monitoring social media channels and trends, and engaging with our community and KOLs to foster relationships and enhance audience engagement. You will also help in compiling performance reports to gauge the effectiveness of our social media strategies.

====================



At Weave, our mission is to evolve how therapeutic knowledge is captured, transformed, and communicated throughout drug development. We do this by equipping human experts with AI instruments to enable drugs to be brought to patients as rapidly, safely, and inexpensively as possible.



The Weave Platform streamlines regulatory workflows from start to finish by intelligently, creatively, and effectively infusing every step with AI. Together with our customers, Weave is designing and building the AI workbench for the entire therapeutic lifecycle.

**The Role \& Your Mission**
============================



We are seeking a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative** to join our commercial team reporting to the VP of Sales. In this role, you will focus on generating leads and new business opportunities within the biotech, pharmaceutical, clinical research organization (CRO) and consulting space offering a transformational solution for regulatory content generation and document management. Your work will help drive the adoption of our AI\-powered platform, enabling clients to streamline regulatory processes, ensure compliance, and accelerate time to market. The day\-to\-day efforts will also drive brand awareness, lead to key partnerships and collaborations, and support the company's hyper growth in a fast\-paced evolving market. This role will be located in our San Francisco HQ office.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* **Lead Generation \& Prospecting**: Research, identify and target potential clients within the biotech, pharmaceutical, CRO and consulting space, with a focus on executives, leaders in regulatory strategy and operations, medical writers and drivers of technology innovation across the industry.
* **Outbound Outreach**: Partner with Weave's Marketing team to execute outbound campaigns via phone, email, and social to engage with prospects and drive interest and demand for the Weave offering.
* **Qualification:** Run initial qualification calls with potential clients, guiding them through the first stages of the evaluation process.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Partner closely with Account Executives to identify, source, and research net new pipeline within strategic accounts and specific lines of business/personas.
* **Product Knowledge**: Work closely with our Product team to maintain a working knowledge of our capabilities, features, benefits, and near\-term roadmap priorities.
* **CRM Utilization**: Accurately track and update lead interactions, qualification status, and pipeline information in CRM tools (HubSpot, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.).
* **Event Participation:** Drive prospect and customer attendance for Weave podcasts, webinars, user groups, and speaking forums.
* **Metrics \& Reporting**: Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for outbound outreach and meetings booked.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================


* **Experience**: 1\+ years of experience in business development or sales with an emphasis on SaaS or software sales, ideally within life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research industries.
* **Communication Skills**: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior\-level decision\-makers in complex industries.
* **Sales Acumen**: Proven ability to engage prospects and create compelling opportunities to move prospects through the sales funnel.
* **Tech\-Savvy**: Comfortable working with CRM systems, email automation tools, and other sales enablement platforms.
* **Self\-Starter**: Highly motivated, organized, and able to work independently to meet or exceed sales targets.
* **Interest in AI \& Automation**: Passion for innovative technologies, particularly AI and automation, and how they can transform business processes.
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field is required.
* Experience with SaaS or document management solutions is required.
* Previous exposure to the biotech, pharmaceutical, or clinical research industry is highly desirable.

 The opportunity to work at a modern, cutting\-edge healthcare technology company devoted to meaningful positive impact on human life. Collaboration, velocity, and customer obsession are our baseline, demonstrations of craftsmanship and ROI are celebrated.



 Competitive salary ($65,000 \- $80,000\) and a quota\-based variable compensation structure with performance\-based incentives (OTE $97,500 to $120,000\) plus equity.

 Career development opportunities within a company entering a growth phase.

jobs.description:
**Department:** General \& Administrative  

**Location:** Oakland, CA  


***Lincoln Families is a workplace that is committed to strengths\-based, culturally responsive, attachment\-centered, and trauma\-informed care.***

  

  

**JOB TITLE:** Executive Assistant


**SALARY:** $75,000 \- $80,000 annually


**POSITION SUMMARY:** Reporting directly to the President \& CEO, the Executive Assistant provides a wide variety of skilled administrative, clerical and executive\-level support for CEO and other Senior Management Team (SMT) members. This position is the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on all matters pertaining to the Office of the CEO which includes, but is not limited to, screening calls, mail and other inquiries and communicating on behalf of CEO and/or SMT. As the most senior administrative position in the Agency, responsibilities involve exposure to sensitive information and require considerable use of tact, diplomacy, discretion and judgment. The Executive Assistant serves as a liaison to the Board of Directors, attends Board or similar meetings to take, transcribe and distribute minutes, prepares Board packets, and coordinates all logistical details. This position also researches or analyzes data and develops reports for management decision\-making and oversees special projects.

  

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


* Perform a wide variety of executive\-level secretarial and administrative duties as required by daily operations in the CEO’s office.
* Develop and recommend office procedures and systems that coordinate activities and schedules, and ensure smooth operations.
* Research and analyze routine administrative projects for the CEO; prepare first draft reports on routine administrative matters.
* Independently create forms, reports manuals, filing systems and the like in order to facilitate completion of Agency business.
* Apply knowledge to gathering information from a variety of resources such as manuals, documentation, consultation with content experts in resolving technical issues and improving processes or operations.
* Research and document background materials for CEO projects.
* Receive and screen communications to the CEO including telephone calls and e\-mail messages, and provide assistance using independent judgment to determine those requiring priority attention; prioritize, channel, and facilitate communication through the CEO’s office.
* Receive and distribute incoming mail for the CEO; review and evaluate mail to identify those items requiring priority attention of the CEO. Independently respond to letters and general correspondence of a routine nature.
* Provide follow up to assignments given to management staff by the CEO/SMT and report status to the CEO/SMT.
* Create charts, graphs, spreadsheets, memos, reports and presentations. Prepare and submit expense reports and other administrative duties as required.
* Maintain appointment schedules and manage CEO’s calendar; this includes scheduling requested meetings, calls and/or conferences and making travel arrangements as needed.
* Provide support for meetings by preparing agendas, summaries and handouts; order refreshments or food and arrange meeting locations.
* Attend weekly SMT, bi\-monthly Board meetings, monthly Board committee meetings and other assigned meetings to take minutes and maintain required documentation. This responsibility includes assisting when requested to prepare and distribute agendas and other materials or coordinating logistics required for meeting (e.g., audio/visual equipment, room reservations) in a timely fashion.
* Manage an efficient file systems and/or databases vital to Agency operations such as private sector agreements and contracts, licenses, permits and various attachments; assures availability and provides this information as needed (e.g., for accreditation and audit purposes).
* Coordinate and help manage special events such as annual All Staff Celebration, special employee activities or meetings, etc.
* Support Board and Board Committees, maintain document files and archive as necessary; maintain web\-based Board portal.
* Manage the process for Restorative Justice facilitators including contracts and scheduling.
* Track and report progress on agency\-wide policies, procedures and strategic plan; this includes communicating with SMT and Board members to stay within timelines.

  

  

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:** The Executive Assistant must be highly motivated and enjoy working within a non\-profit environment that is mission\-driven, community\-based and results\-oriented. Will be a positive, service\-focused team player who is able to work independently in a fast\-paced work environment and manage priorities effectively under the pressure of sometimes competing deadlines. Must have the ability to exercise sound judgment and quick thinking in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with staff members and stakeholders at all levels with cultural humility. Maintains the highest level of confidentiality, has exceptional organizational skills, and exhibits a continuous improvement mentality with the ability to design and implement administrative systems and procedures. Must be able to problem\-solve and maintain composure and poise while handling crises effectively, be willing to adapt in ever\-changing environment and demonstrate high reliability and stability in long\-term commitment. The Executive Assistant must be extremely flexible in schedule/availability as this position may require an extended workday, including late evenings and weekends.

* Bachelor’s degree required (equivalent experience may be considered)
* At least 3 years of experience as administrative assistant with progressive responsibilities; previous experience at the Executive Assistant level is preferred
* Experience working with Board of Directors is

**Job Description**
-------------------


The New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA)’s Office of Resident Economic Empowerment \& Sustainability (REES), situated within NYCHA’s Department of Resident Services, Partnerships and Initiatives (RSPI), is charged with working to develop and implement programs, policies and collaborations to measurably support residents increased economic opportunities with a focus on asset building, employment, advancement, adult education and training, and business development.
  

  

NYCHA has implemented a Zone Model approach, which leverages NYCHA’s and partner resources to expand economic opportunity for public housing residents through place\-based service coordination. Through this new approach, REES enables NYCHA to (1\) Generate more economic opportunities for NYCHA residents and NYCHA neighborhoods, while strategically investing and leveraging NYCHA’s spend; (2\) Provide a more comprehensive economic empowerment platform with additional capacities around financial literacy, asset building and business development; (3\) Reduce the duplication of services – better investing limited resources; (4\) Enable NYCHA to be a better partner to community\-based organizations, government agencies, philanthropies, community colleges, schools, employers and other key stakeholders; and (5\) Drive more resources and investment into public housing neighborhoods.
  

  

REES seeks a dynamic Project Coordinator, Financial Capability to join the Financial Capability and Resident Business Development unit, which develops strategies, programs and initiatives geared towards increasing economic outcomes for NYCHA residents in the areas of financial literacy/counseling and asset building to achieve the following goals: starting or increasing savings; accessing mainstream financial services; establishing and/or improving credit; reducing debt and increasing free tax preparation usage.
  

  

Reporting to the Assistant Director of Financial Capability and Business Development, duties of the Project Coordinator, Financial Capability include, but are not limited to the following:
  

  

1\. Independently manage a portfolio of financial literacy and asset building projects, including but not exclusive to Free Tax Preparation Services, Credit\-Building (including rent reporting as a credit building tool), and Homeownership initiatives (including NYCHA related homeownership opportunities).
  

2\. Support the Assistant Director in the facilitation and structuring of strategic plans and special projects.
  

3\. Organize, host and co\-facilitate quarterly professional development trainings for financial counselors who work to improve economic outcomes for NYCHA residents.
  

4\. Work with the REES Assistant Director, Financial Capability and Business Development to adequately maintain key performance indicators.
  

5\. Foster and manage partnerships with various community based and citywide financial capability organizations and sister City agencies to facilitate necessary service referrals and achievement of the stated economic goals for NYCHA residents.
  

6\. Communicate with REES partners and industry experts to assess financial capability trends and best practices.
  

7\. Attend internal and external meetings with various administering departments and key stakeholders. Make recommendations on policies and procedures.
  

8\. Represent REES at occasional evening meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  

  

Additional Information
  

  

1\. NYCHA employees applying for transfer, promotional, title or level change opportunities must have served a period of one year at current location and in current title and level (if applicable).
  

2\. NYCHA residents are encouraged to apply.
  

3\. NYCHA provides benefits that include a choice of medical coverage plans, deferred compensation plans and a defined pension benefit plan as a member of the New York City Employees’ Retirement System (NYCERS).
  

  

Please read this posting carefully to make certain you meet the minimum qualification requirements before applying to this position.
  

  

COMMUNITY COORDINATOR \- 56058

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Heritage: An American Original Since 1977**


Founded on the Upper East Side of New York City by brothers Jay and Kevin McLaughlin, J.McLaughlin was built on a simple idea: great style feels personal.


From a single neighborhood shop to nearly 200 stores nationwide, we have always believed in being local and loyal—to our customers, our communities, and one another. Today, nearly 1,000 employees bring the brand to life across the country, from Maine to Maui.


For over 20 years, our corporate home has been in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, where creativity, craftsmanship, and collaboration continue to shape our next chapter.


Giving back is part of who we are. We support the communities we serve through local partnerships, charitable initiatives, and a belief that businesses should leave places better than they found them.

**Overview**


We are seeking a Logistics Coordinator to join our Product Development and Supply Chain team, reporting to our Director of Production. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating purchase orders and inbound logistics activities from PO issuance through delivery of goods to the warehouse. This role will work closely with internal teams, vendors, freight forwarders, and warehouse partners to ensure timely and accurate shipment execution.


This position is primarily based in our Greenpoint, Brooklyn office and follows a hybrid schedule, dependent on role and business needs.

**About the role**

* Issue Purchase Orders and ensure all PO information is accurate and complete.
* Maintain and update POs, including changes to quantities, delivery dates, shipping details, and other key information.
* Work closely with freight forwarders to coordinate vessel bookings and shipment schedules.
* Review and approve vessel bookings to ensure alignment with required delivery timelines.
* Coordinate consolidation of goods across vendors and Purchase Orders to support efficient shipments.
* Monitor shipment status and key milestones from cargo readiness through vessel departure and final delivery.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders and warehouse teams to ensure timely delivery of goods into the warehouse.
* Maintain accurate PO, shipment, and delivery information in company systems.
* Maintain and publish transit lead\-time charts by country and port to support Production planning.
* Report shipment delays and potential delivery risks to the Production team on a weekly basis.
* Calculate and publish freight costs by product category and region to support costing, budgeting, and freight cost management.
* Proactively identify, communicate, and escalate potential shipment delays or logistics issues.
* Partner with Sourcing, Production, vendors, forwarders, and warehouse teams to ensure alignment on order and delivery status.

**What we are looking for**


Skills \& Requirements:

* 2\-4 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, import/export, or purchase order management.
* Experience working with international freight forwarders and coordinating ocean shipments.
* Strong organizational, communication, and follow\-up skills.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple POs and shipments simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP or PO management systems.
* Experience in apparel, retail, or consumer goods preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, working on a computer, standing, bending and kneeling.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds occasionally.
* Must be able to access and navigate various department at the organization's facilities.

**Benefits at a Glance**


At J.McLaughlin, we design our benefits with the same care and intention as our product. Our benefits are designed to support well\-being, flexibility, and long\-term growth.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match (eligibility based on hours worked)
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays
* Hybrid or flexible work environment (role\-dependent)
* Company\-paid life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional Critical Illness and Accident insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Clothing allowance and generous discounts on J.McLaughlin merchandise
* Discretionary bonus opportunities (role\-dependent)
* Employee referral incentives and commuter benefits

**Pay Transparency \& Disclaimer**


$27\.50 \- $33\.50, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.  

Compensation and benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility. J.McLaughlin reserves the right to modify compensation and benefit programs at any time, in accordance with applicable laws.

**Equal Opportunity**


J.McLaughlin is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Our Ambient team includes experienced professionals who focus on cost\-effective solutions for our clients.

  

  

**Job Description**  



**MIH Systems Group** is hiring an Administrator to support back\-office and executive operations across our New York business lines. This is a broad, hands\-on role combining HR/payroll administration, customer and billing support, travel logistics, and direct executive assistant support to the Vice President and Operations Director. It's well\-suited to someone who is detail\-obsessed, comfortable handling sensitive financial and personnel information, and energized by supporting multiple business lines at once rather than a single narrow function.


This role is a coordination/conduit function, not a decision\-owning one: the Administrator submits payroll, requests COIs, and routes customer paperwork, rather than administering payroll or the insurance program itself. That keeps the required seniority consistent across the role's responsibilities — this should be priced and titled as a coordinator\-level position, not an HR/benefits\-specialist role.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Submit payroll data on behalf of staff each cycle (manual process until automated)
* Serve as the point of contact between the team and payroll provider, ensuring timely and accurate submission
* Request certificates of insurance (COIs) from the broker for projects, vendors, and contracts as needed
* Track COI requests through to completion and maintain records for project files
* Collect client information (W\-9\), and set up them up in our business systems
* Support billing and invoicing workflows; assist with accounts receivable follow\-up as needed
* Book employee travel per existing SOP (refundable fares, corporate travel accounts)
* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for field engineers and leadership travel
* Provide direct administrative support to the Vice President and Operations Director, including calendar management, correspondence, and task follow\-up
* Assist with document preparation and light project coordination as needed
* Serve as a central administrative point of contact across business units
* Handle administrative projects as priorities shift across business lines

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of administrative or coordinator experience; exposure to payroll submission, insurance/COI requests, or customer onboarding processes a plus (not required to have owned these functions)
* Comfortable handling confidential financial and personnel data with discretion
* Strong follow\-through — this role is a conduit between the team and outside parties (payroll provider, insurance broker, customers), so nothing can fall through the cracks
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units
* Knowledge of HVAC/Construction background is preferred
* Experience with Dynamic365, CRM systems, or similar business platforms a plus
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work on\-site in New York, NY

**Estimated Salary:** $73,000 \- $88,000 annually with flexibility based on experience and skills.

This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. eysight’s Global Services organization is seeking an **Expert\-Level Services Account Manager** to drive strategic growth, expand multi\-year service contracts, and deepen account penetration across enterprise, semiconductor, aerospace \& defense, and communications customers in the Mid Atlantic region.

* Develop multi\-year **Lifecycle Services** strategies tied to customer technology roadmaps and test modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the trusted advisor on test asset strategy, uptime optimization, calibration programs, and operational risk reduction.
* Lead executive\-level service reviews, QBRs, and long\-term service planning discussions.

**Sales Growth \& Business Development*** Drive YoY growth across all Keysight service offerings, consistently delivering against quota and profitability targets.
* Identify whitespace within accounts and introduce advanced solutions including **KeysightCare, Repair \& Calibration Services, Asset Optimization, Test Ops, Managed Services, and Test Automation software services**.
* Build multi\-year contracts leveraging Keysight’s regional service centers and onsite managed service capabilities.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and service deliverables at expert level.

**Customer Relationship Management*** Own C‑suite, VP\-level, and Director\-level service relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and long\-term retention.
* Engage deeply with engineering, metrology, operations, production, and program teams to understand mission requirements.
* Serve as escalation point for critical service events, outage mitigation, or urgent operational support.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership*** Partner with Field Sales, Services Delivery, Service Centers, Technical Support, and Solutions Consulting to execute customer strategy.

* Lead internal teams during RFPs, contract renewals, and technical solution development.

**Required*** 8–12\+ years in technical account management, services sales, or lifecycle services roles (preferably in test \& measurement, A\&D, semiconductor, telecom, or electronics industries).

* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise customers and close multi\-year service agreements.
* Strong business acumen in negotiation, commercial structuring, and value\-based selling.
* Ability to confidently lead customer executive reviews, service strategy sessions, and program readiness meetings.

* Relationship building at all levels

**Outside Sales Representative – New Territory Development**

Stonehenge US

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to help develop new business and expand our dealer network throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

This is a true business\-development position. We already have established sales territories throughout New Jersey and New York, and this position will focus primarily on identifying, scouting, opening, and developing new dealer accounts in markets where we are looking to grow.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary
* Commission of approximately $12,000 for every $1 million in sales
* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full\-time position
* Primarily field\-based outside sales

This is a developing territory, so we understand that it will take time to build relationships, open dealers, and grow the sales volume. The base salary provides stability while the territory is being developed, with additional earning potential as sales grow.

**Company\-Provided Vehicle \& Equipment**

Stonehenge US provides the tools needed to operate effectively in the field, including:

* Company Ford F\-150
* Company gas card
* Company E\-ZPass
* Company cell phone
* Company iPad

**Territory \& Location**

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York, but this position will spend the majority of its time in the field developing new business throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

Because of the territory, a candidate located in or near our Staten island warehouse or South Jersey particularly areas such as Cherry Hill, Marlton, Voorhees, Maple Shade, Mount Laurel, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role, with convenient access to Philadelphia, southeastern Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey.

The salesperson will also need to travel to our Staten Island location periodically for meetings, training, samples, promotional materials, and other sales needs.

The position is not limited to South Jersey candidates. We are primarily looking for the right person who is comfortable traveling throughout the territory and actively developing new markets.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Researching and identifying new masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, building material, lumber, and related dealers
* Scouting new markets throughout Pennsylvania and Delaware
* Cold calling and scheduling meetings with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision\-makers
* Visiting prospective dealers and learning their existing product mix and suppliers

We are looking for someone who is comfortable building a territory rather than simply maintaining an existing customer list.

* Self\-motivated
* Organized
* Persistent
* Comfortable cold calling and walking into new businesses
* Able to research and qualify prospects independently

* Able to plan productive routes and manage time efficiently

Experience in building materials, masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, stone, pavers, construction products, or contractor sales is strongly preferred, although we will consider candidates with strong outside B2B sales experience.

This position requires regular travel throughout the assigned market, particularly Pennsylvania and Delaware, so the candidate should be comfortable spending most working days in the field.

**About Stonehenge US**

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor\-living products serving building\-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

We are continuing to expand our dealer network and are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to build a territory, develop long\-term dealer relationships, and grow their income as the territory grows.

You don't need years of sales experience to be successful here. We're much more interested in how you learn, how hard you're willing to work at something, how you respond when things don't go your way, and how much ownership you take over your own development.


In return, we're going to invest heavily in you.


You'll get regular coaching, role plays, call reviews, structured training, and a manager whose job isn't just to inspect your number, but to help you become a better seller. As you prove you're ready for more, you'll have opportunities to take on more responsibility and continue growing your career at Topline Pro.

**Growth here isn't about waiting your turn. It's about showing you're ready.**

**What the job actually looks like**
====================================


This is a high\-energy, high\-expectation sales environment. You'll be in our Williamsburg office five days a week, surrounded by people who want to get better and want the people around them to get better too. Our office is dog\-friendly and in the historic Domino Sugar Refinery at Domino Park.


You'll:

* Prospect home service business owners through high\-volume calling, email, and other outreach.
* Learn how to run great discovery conversations and understand what actually matters to a small business owner.
* Demo Topline Pro and connect our product to the problems you're hearing.
* Manage your own pipeline and learn how to move opportunities from first conversation through close.
* Participate regularly in coaching, role plays, call reviews, and team training.
* Get direct feedback and be expected to put it into practice quickly.
* Learn from your teammates, share what's working, and contribute to making the entire team better.
* Use our CRM and sales tools consistently to manage follow\-ups, prioritize opportunities, and stay organized.
* Learn how to use technology and AI to work smarter and become a more effective seller.
* Own your results. We'll give you coaching, tools, support, and opportunity, but what you do with them is up to you.

**Who tends to thrive here**
============================


We're less concerned with whether you've sold SaaS before and more interested in the person you're becoming. You'll probably love this environment if:

* **You want to get really good at something.** You're not just looking for your next job. You want to build skills and a career.
* **You're coachable.** You don't just listen to feedback. You try it, practice it, and come back better.
* **You're competitive with yourself.** You care about winning, but you're especially motivated by seeing yourself improve.
* **You're resilient.** Sales involves rejection. A bad call, bad day, or bad week doesn't change how you show up tomorrow.
* **You're curious.** You ask questions, want to understand why something works, and aren't satisfied memorizing a script.
* **You work hard.** There's no shortcut around the reps required to become great at sales.
* **You take ownership.** When something isn't working, your first instinct is to figure out what you can do differently.
* **You're a great teammate.** We compete, but not at each other's expense. We share what's working, help each other improve, and celebrate when someone else wins.
* **You're comfortable with change.** We're a fast\-growing company and we're constantly learning. Processes, messaging, and priorities will evolve as we get better.
* **You communicate well.** You can build trust with small business owners and communicate in a way that's clear, professional, and human.


Previous sales experience is helpful, but it isn't required. We're looking for people with the raw ingredients to become great sellers and the willingness to put in the work to get there.

**Where this can take you**
===========================


We want ambitious people.


This role is meant to build the foundation for a career in sales, and we want Topline Pro to be a place where you can keep building that career.


As you demonstrate mastery of the role, you'll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility, work more complex opportunities, and continue progressing as a seller.


We don't believe career growth should happen simply because you've been here long enough. **Opportunity is earned by showing you're ready for it.**


If you're looking for a comfortable job where you can blend into the middle of the pack, this probably won't be the right environment.


If you're looking for a place that will challenge you, coach you, invest in you, and give you the opportunity to grow faster than you thought possible, we'd love to meet you.

**Hiring Process**
==================


Our interview process is designed to get to know you beyond your resume and give you a chance to get to know us too. We'll be looking for the same qualities throughout the process that we value once you're here: curiosity, coachability, resilience, ownership, communication, and a genuine desire to grow.

* Recruiter Screen
* Sales Manager Screen
* Roleplay
* Leadership Screen

**What we offer**
=================

* $55k base salary with uncapped commissions ($100k\+ OTE) \+ equity package
* Full Medical, Dental, and Vision Health Coverage
* Computer and workspace enhancements
* 401(k) plan (non\-matching)
* Unlimited vacation, 9 company holidays, including election day, and 1 personal volunteer day a year
* Company\-paid Wellhu

* Know your Client! Learn, and maintain, knowledge of Client Accounts; understand their Perfect Market
