**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or related field
* A minimum of 0\-2 years’ professional experience
* Agency experience, *preferred*
* Automotive Agency, Automotive In\-House Marketing and/or Customer Service experience, *preferred*
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* Extremely organized, task and detailed\-oriented
* Must be a critical thinker
* Exceptional communication skills, demonstrated ability to write, listen and articulate in a clear, concise, and professional manner
* Demonstrated ability to proactively take ownership of projects
* Ability to establish priorities and objectives
* Must be flexible in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment

This entry\-level position offers a starting salary of $48,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus variable opportunity, as well as participation in company benefits offerings including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, wellness, and more.

If you are interested in this position and believe your experience is a perfect fit, please COMPLETE the online application. Please be sure to include a current resume along with your contact information. Incomplete submissions will not be considered. No phone calls please.

Team Velocity is revolutionizing the automotive industry with cutting\-edge technology to help dealers sell and service more cars. Our vision is to serve our clients with a single technology platform that empowers them to execute intelligent marketing across every online and offline channel. We aim to deliver a frictionless consumer experience, from the initial engagement to a final transaction.

jobs.title: Account Manager 2, Merchant Services Managed Money Accounts
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

  

As a Merchant Services Account Manager, you play a vital role in driving growth and protecting revenue for our mid\-market customers. Your primary objective is to deeply engage with customers, gaining a thorough understanding of their business needs across all locations. Leveraging your expertise, you'll demonstrate our core capabilities and recommend the right merchant processing solution stack to meet their specific requirements. Collaborating with internal support partners and resources, you'll ensure seamless execution of our solutions, contributing to Intuit's mission of disrupting the small business mid\-market segment. **Responsibilities**

* Exemplify Intuit's values and foster an inclusive environment conducive to collaboration and innovation.
* Proactively identify opportunities to drive business improvements for existing customers, providing strategic recommendations aligned with their needs.
* Articulate Intuit's value propositions within the merchant services domain, showcasing understanding of our strategies and products relative to competitors.
* Deliver compelling presentations to C\-level executives, effectively communicating ROI and value propositions.
* Grow and manage a robust sales funnel, maintaining a sustainable sales cycle to meet quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to influence the buying process and navigate complex selling processes.
* Serve as a cross\-functional facilitator, leveraging resources to support business relationship growth and execution.
* Utilize all available resources to efficiently close deals and drive scalability.
* Measure success through key metrics including quota attainment, close rates, pipeline velocity, and retention improvements.

 **Qualifications**

* Minimum 5\+ years of quota\-carrying software or technology sales and corporate account management experience.
* Extensive experience in territory management across multiple states and industries, preferably within the merchant services domain.
* Deep understanding of Account Receivable and Account Payable processes related to money movement.
* Familiarity with merchant services customers owning multiple locations and annual revenues exceeding $5M.
* Familiarity with merchant service industry standards as it relates to rates, cost analysis, and risk management.
* Experience selling merchant services platform solutions with negotiated rates/terms across various industries.
* Strong business acumen and sales skills, with the ability to innovate and iterate.
* Prior experience with accounting, ERP, or financial management software sales.
* Proficiency in managing a large prospect pipeline through Salesforce and supporting multiple partners through the sales process.
* Familiarity with key sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN, Solution, or Sandler.
* Understanding of the client management lifecycle and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or MBA preferred or equivalent work experience.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

Mountain View, CA $100,000\- $135,000

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT REPAY
  

REPAY (“Realtime Electronic Payments” / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast\-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.


ABOUT THE ROLE


REPAY is seeking an Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) to serve as a trusted technical advisor to our strategic enterprise clients. The eTAM will own the ongoing technical relationship with an assigned portfolio of complex clients, developing a deep understanding of their technical environments, integrations, payment workflows, and business priorities.


This highly visible, client\-facing role partners closely with clients and internal teams to ensure the ongoing performance and success of REPAY solutions. The eTAM will provide technical guidance, manage complex technical issues and escalations, **and help clients optimize and expand their use of REPAY's technology.**

The eTAM will work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, and Sales to advocate for client needs and drive successful outcomes.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor and key point of contact for assigned enterprise clients, developing a strong understanding of their business needs, technical environments, and use of REPAY solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions.
* Provide technical guidance and consultation to clients throughout the lifecycle of the relationship, helping them navigate REPAY's products, capabilities, and integrations.
* Partner with clients and internal teams to understand technical needs, identify solutions, and support successful outcomes.
* Proactively identify potential technical risks, challenges, and opportunities within assigned client relationships and help drive appropriate action.
* Coordinate and support the resolution of complex technical issues and client escalations, engaging the appropriate internal resources as needed.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, Sales, and other teams to address client needs and priorities.
* Serve as an advocate for enterprise clients internally, helping communicate client feedback, business needs, technical requirements, and emerging priorities.
* Support the adoption and ongoing success of REPAY products and solutions within assigned enterprise accounts.
* Provide technical insight and support for client discussions, strategic initiatives, new opportunities, and evolving business needs.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen REPAY's enterprise client experience, technical account management practices, and internal processes.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge of REPAY's products, technology, integrations, and industry trends to effectively advise and support clients.
* Perform other responsibilities and support strategic initiatives as needed based on evolving client and business needs.
* Rotating assignment for technical off\-hours on\-call support of our strategic enterprise accounts.

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE NEEDED**

* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Engineering, or a similar client\-facing technical role.
* Experience supporting enterprise or complex clients within a SaaS, fintech, payments, or technology environment.
* Strong understanding of API\-based integrations, including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, and system\-to\-system integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex technical issues and coordinate resolution across multiple technical teams.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, integrations, and workflows.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with both technical stakeholders and senior business leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients, initiatives, escalations, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive, ownership\-oriented approach.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and Account Management organizations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience within payments, fintech, financial services technology, or another highly integrated transaction\-processing environment.
* Knowledge of payment processing concepts, including card and ACH transaction flows, payment gateways, settlement, reconciliation, tokenization, and payment security.
* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools such as Postman.
* Familiarity with SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, or similar technical troubleshooting methods.
* Experience supporting high\-volume, mission\-critical platforms or complex enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS and other security or compliance requirements applicable to payment proce

jobs.description:

* USD $173,000\.00/Yr.


  
**Job Description**
-------------------


Established nearly two centuries ago, FM is a leading mutual insurance company whose capital, scientific research capability and engineering expertise are solely dedicated to property risk management and the resilience of its policyholder\-owners. These owners, who share the belief that the majority of property loss is preventable, represent many of the world’s largest organizations, including one of every four Fortune 500 companies. They work with FM to better understand the hazards that can impact their business continuity to make cost\-effective risk management decisions, combining property loss prevention with insurance protection.


FM's Atlanta, Georgia Operation has an opening for a dynamic Account Manager in our Client Service Department. This position will perform insurance servicing and underwriting activities on existing accounts and new business. This position's primary function is to serve as the account team leader or manager of the account. Serve as key/primary interface with clients/brokers on all aspects of the account including insurance products and services, engineering, and claims services.


**This position is for an AM I to AM II, depending on the level of the candidate’s skill and experience. Varying levels of experience and qualifications will be considered.**


* Maintain a profitable book of business by effective use of sales techniques, client relationships, risk assessments, application of sound underwriting principles and creative use of underwriting resources.
* Ensure premium growth by retaining existing clients through value added service, by selling additional product lines and by establishing equitable terms and conditions on new accounts introduced by sales executives. Ensure policies accurately reflect both the insured’s and FM's intent of coverage.
* Provide professional advice and consultation to all clients on insurance coverages and risk management matters making them aware of the benefits derived from various products and services offered by FM.
* In coordination with Account Engineers, establish risk improvement priorities and support efforts to acquire client compliance with loss prevention recommendations.
* Protect FM's assets through creative use of company underwriting programs and adherence to published guidelines which include: Line setting techniques, judicious purchase of reinsurance (where warranted), timely issuance of policies, catastrophe aggregate analysis, MFL analysis and cross liability checks.
* Collect outstanding premium balances in a timely manner to meet the Operation’s goals and objectives.
* Continue professional development including maintaining necessary licensing. Continue to update knowledge of underwriting guidelines, policy forms, loss prevention practices and insurance industry developments.
* Provide leadership to the overall FM account team, ensuring that the Client Service Process is implemented effectively and efficiently.
* Handle change by prioritizing routine activities, workloads, and projects and through delegating to support staff as necessary.
* Evaluate manuscript coverage/wording requests: analyze existing policy language; degree and type of exposure; pricing; and develop additional policy language if warranted.

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; CPCU or ARM desired!
* Minimum 5\+ years FM experience or 5\+ years industry experience (broker, insurance, reinsurance company) in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* FM loss prevention engineering background desired.
* Previous experience as an Underwriter for FM is desired.
* Power Generation Loss Prevention or Underwriting experience is desired.
* Demonstrated effectiveness at accessing and influencing the decision maker.
* Strong familiarity with FM's client service process preferred.
* Experience in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* Working knowledge of property insurance and forms, financial statements, general loss prevention engineering terms and concepts as well as business computer applications.
* Demonstrated above average ability in organization, problem solving, sales/negotiation, leadership and team building skills.
* Knowledge of internal systems and Microsoft Office products.

The final salary offer will vary based on geographic location, individual education, skills, and experience. The position is eligible to participate in FM’s comprehensive Total Rewards program that includes an incentive plan, generous health, and well\-being programs, a 401(k) and pension plan, career development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, flexible work, time off allowances, and much more!


FM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce.

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry\-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting\-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and be part of an innovative, mission\-driven team, apply now!
  
  

Key Account Manager – Home Depot, Pro \& Field Sales
  
**Location:** Remote – Atlanta Metro
  
**Base Salary Rate:** $126,684\.00\.00 \- $149,040\.00
  
**Job type:** Full\-time
  
  

About This Role
  
The Key Account Manager – Home Depot Pro and Field Sales will oversee all aspects of Quote Center, Pro Desk, Field Sales and Training for the THD account team. This role is accountable for building a strong relationship with Home Depot Field and PRO leadership to achieve annual sales objectives. The position is responsible for training and cultivating all outside Pro sales personnel and working with inside Pro sales personnel in closing new business opportunities with single\-family home builders, multi\-family developers/contractors, and remodeling companies. The Account Manager is responsible for ensuring all sales programs are known to Pro and Field personnel to drive revenue and market share.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Accountable for developing and achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while positioning the Pro business for continued growth.
* Provide monthly field communication with any relevant product and building code updates.
* Regularly review and analyze business performance to identify areas for improvement.
* Lead regional and store training events (RVP Walks, PRO events, etc.)
* Develop relationships with Store and PRO personnel and be the primary point of contact for all PRO and Field Sales needs.
* Develop training materials to help PRO and Field Sales personnel gain the necessary knowledge of the fire safety category and “Why Kidde”.
* Serve as a point of contact for Quote Center/Pro teams; ensure timely follow\-ups or requests. connecting with and following up with requests from stores and sales associates
* Support Quote Center/PRO business by monitoring product availability, pricing accuracy, and order fulfillment to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Oversee third\-party field service resources supporting The Home Depot, responsible for managing the relationship, performance, and execution of these field service activities.


Basic Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 5\+ years of Key Account Management experience
* OR
* High School Diploma or Equivalent
* 7\+ years of Key Account Management experience


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Proficiency in MS office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Power BI).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate plans and strategy for The Home Depot PRO/Field Sales account.
* Comfortable creating training courses and presenting to groups of 20\+ people.
* Self\-starter with an ability to work independently and drive projects from initiation to completion.
* Bachelor’s Degree with 7\+ years of direct experience or equivalent industry experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30% of the time
* This position will be remote, preferably based near Atlanta, GA


Compensation and Benefits
  
Individuals may be eligible for an annual performance bonus based on both individual and company’s performance. The final compensation for this position will be set based on the individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience as it relates to the job requirements. Kidde Global Solutions is committed to providing a competitive benefits package to our employees including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement plan, paid time off (vacation, sick, company holidays), 401(k) with employer match, EAP assistance, and more.
  
World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety
  
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire \& life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry\-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Powering more than 80,000\+ companies, 2\.5 million worksite employees, and $85 billion in payroll processed annually, PrismHR is the most efficient, reliable, and scalable software solution to help PEOs and ASOs grow and prosper. The PrismHR platform is a complete, integrated HR solution supporting the full "hire\-to\-retire” lifecycle of HR services. And PrismHR provides a wide range of additional resources that go beyond just technology and support: PrismHR SEEDS sales and marketing program, the annual PrismHR LIVE Conference, and numerous learning opportunities throughout the year are all designed specifically to help PrismHR customers grow their business.
Position Summary
The Account Manager is responsible for the oversight and ongoing management of their assigned clients. The Account Manager works with sales and the support teams to implement new or renewing accounts, ensuring that a high service level is met. The Account Manager will also work with high\-level, key employees to maintain the ongoing client relationships. Are you passionate about digital marketing and helping businesses grow? Do you have experience leading franchise or non\-franchise enterprise accounts? * **Commercial Instinct:** An intuitive ability to read a client's business model, spot upsell signals naturally, and sense portfolio risks before they appear on paper.
* **Resilience \& Composure:** Calm under pressure. Bounces back quickly from difficult calls or unexpected shifts, resetting with solution\-focused energy.
* **Smart \& Curious:** Fast on your feet, highly inquisitive, and eager to connect the dots between digital performance data and real business outcomes.
* **Coachability \& Drive:** Holds a high personal standard for work quality, seeks feedback actively, and brings a continuous hunger to learn and win.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5\+ years as an account lead, Account Manager, Key Account Manager, or Account Executive in a digital marketing/advertising agency supporting franchise or B2B/B2C enterprise clients.
* **Channel Expertise:** Strong, well\-rounded understanding of digital marketing channels including Paid Media, SEO, Website Development, Analytics, and UX.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated experience and success in sales, account growth, upselling, and owning client retention metrics.
* **Strategic Communication:** Exceptional listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities with proven success building rapport with business executives.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:** Highly proactive in identifying business development opportunities, juggling complex agency projects, and navigating high\-growth environments.
* **Detail \& Big\-Picture Balance:** Sharp attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to grasp overarching client business goals.
* **Location:** Must be a legal resident currently residing in one of the 50 United States.

### **Why Ignite Visibility?**

* **Industry Acclaim:** Top\-Tier Franchise Marketing Supplier by *Entrepreneur Magazine* (20182024\), 2x Landy Award Winner, and 8\-time *Inc. 5000* honoree.

jobs.title: BILINGUAL SPANISH Social Media Manager / Content Creator
jobs.description:
About the Role

Melo Vision Media is looking for a Bilingual Content Creator / Social Media Assistant to join our growing team in the Atlanta area.

This is a paid, flexible position focused mainly on helping us create content for our local clients. You’ll be our on\-the\-ground support in Atlanta, while our remote team handles social media strategy, graphic design, editing, scheduling, and overall marketing.

Most of our clients are restaurants and hospitality\-based businesses, so we’re looking for someone who is creative, outgoing, comfortable working with clients, and understands how to capture content that feels natural and engaging on social media.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your main responsibility will be attending content shoots for different clients throughout the month. Depending on our schedule, this may be around 1–2 shoots per week, with the amount of work varying as we add new clients.

You’ll be responsible for:

* Filming short\-form content for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, etc.
* Taking photos and capturing additional behind\-the\-scenes content when needed.
* Coming to shoots prepared with content ideas and helping direct what we capture.
* Communicating directly with clients to coordinate shoot dates, times, and availability.
* Uploading and organizing all footage into our shared folders after each shoot so our remote team can edit and publish it.
* Occasionally attending meetings or introductions with new clients.
* Becoming a reliable local point of contact for Melo Vision Media and our Atlanta\-area clients.

What We’re Looking For

Bilingual Spanish \+ English is required. This is one of the most important requirements for the position since many of our clients are Spanish\-speaking and/or Latin American businesses.

Being familiar with South American/Latin American culture is a big plus, especially since several of our restaurant clients are South American. We want someone who understands the culture, food, humor, hospitality, and customer experience enough to create content that feels authentic.

You should also:

* Have your own reliable transportation and be comfortable driving to different client locations.
* Have an iPhone with a good\-quality camera for filming content.
* Have access to a computer to upload and organize large photo/video files.
* Be comfortable communicating directly with business owners and clients.
* Be outgoing, responsible, organized, and creative.
* Understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and current social media trends.
* Be comfortable working independently during shoots.

Locations

Our current shoots are primarily around:

Suwanee **Lawrenceville**  Monroe **Smyrna**  Atlanta

Because locations vary depending on the client, reliable transportation is essential.

Schedule \& Pay

This is a flexible, paid position rather than a traditional 9–5 role. The number of shoots may vary from week to week depending on our client schedule.

Compensation will be discussed based on availability, experience, and the number of shoots assigned.

There is also room for the position to grow as Melo Vision Media takes on more clients. Over time, we’d love for this person to become our right hand in Atlanta for content creation and local client relationships.

If you love social media, enjoy creating content, are comfortable working with people, and want hands\-on experience working with different brands and businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Pay: From $15\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Atlanta, GA 30303

**About Us**

GrinderCrusherScreen has been in the heavy equipment business since 1973\. We sell, broker, and support grinders, crushers, screening plants, and the wear parts that keep them running. Our customers are land clearing crews, recycling yards, compost operations, and contractors across the country. When their machine is down, they call us.

We are small, fast moving, and we promote from the inside.

**The Role**

This is an entry level seat in our parts department. You do not need equipment experience. You need to be reliable, comfortable on the phone, and willing to learn a real trade.

You will spend your day talking to customers. Some of them call us. Most of them we call. Your job is to keep our existing customers buying and to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**What You'll Do**

* Make outbound calls to past customers to check on their equipment, their wear parts usage, and their upcoming needs
* Answer inbound calls, help where you can, and route the rest to the right person quickly
* Quote parts orders (screens, wear tips, and related components) using our pricing guidelines
* Enter and maintain customer records, quotes, and follow ups in our CRM
* Follow up on open quotes until you get a yes or a no
* Coordinate with our parts and technical team on lead times, shipping, and order status
* Learn the equipment: what a grinder is, what a screen does, and why the right part matters

**What We're Looking For**

* Dependable and on time, every day
* Clear, confident phone communication and comfort making outbound calls
* Basic computer skills and a willingness to learn our CRM (we will train you)
* Organized enough to track your own follow ups without being reminded
* Coachable, curious, and interested in learning an industry from the ground up
* High school diploma or equivalent

**Nice to have, not required:**

* Conversational Spanish
* Prior phone, retail, counter sales, or customer service experience
* Any exposure to parts, equipment, automotive, or construction

**What You'll Get**

* $22\.00 to $25\.00 per hour, based on experience
* Part time or full time, we will build the schedule around the right person
* Hands on training in parts, pricing, and equipment
* A clear path into a sales career in an industry most people never hear about
* A team small enough that your work is visible

**To Apply**

Apply through this posting with your resume. If you do not have a resume, send us a short note about where you have worked and why this interests you. We read everything.

GrinderCrusherScreen is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - East Coast
jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the East Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the East Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the East Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the East Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Living and located on the Central to East Coast, USA
* Hospitality experience required
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles
* AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands\-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result


**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**



Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.



This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.



If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process \- your recruiter will be able to help.


#### **What's in it for you?**



Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.


#### **Global benefits**



No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:


* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work\-from\-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**



You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

We're an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serv

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

  

  

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional\-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia\-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36\.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world\-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close\-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back\-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move\-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on\-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make\-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.
* May assist and/or support leasing and marketing efforts by greeting prospective residents, gathering information about the prospect via the Guest Card, showing ready apartments and models, closing and obtaining the lease deposit, and assisting the prospective resident in completing the rental application and credit verification.


* For California Only: The Assistant Community Manager or Leasing Manager must review all completed move in files prior to submission to the Community Manager for review and approval.


**BASIC KNOWLEDGE \& QUALIFICATIONS:**
--------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Communications, or related field from an accredited college or university is preferred.
* 1\-3 years minimum of relevant experience in residence life and/or property management that demonstrates the application of community management, sales, marketing, and customer service background sufficient to assist in managing the day\-to\-day operations of an apartment community, resolve customer complaints and issues, complete financial records, documents, and reports, increase sales revenues, and coordinate the work of a team.
* Understanding of lease terms and lease enforcement, including collections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS:**
-----------------------


* Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
* Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents.
* Strong proficiency in using property management software (Yardi, OneSite, Entrata, etc.).

**TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**
------------------------------


* Team members work in an office environment but also may have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperature, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous. Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior

jobs.description:
Mayfair Arts Center  
8701 S. Bennett Ave, Chicago, IL 60617

Company Status: Nonprofit Organization – Performing Arts/Arts Education  
Compensation: Commensurate with Experience  
Hours: Part\-time, in\-person, 24 hrs/week (additional hours during programs) Strong opportunity for growth  
Start Date: September/October 2026

About the position  
Chicago Human Rhythm Project (CHRP) is the nation’s largest and only year\-round presenter of American tap dance and contemporary percussive arts. We are seeking a Facilities and Programs Operations Coordinator to manage day\-to\-day operations of the Mayfair Arts Center, our arts incubator in Calumet Heights, along with production coordination of our seasonal and core education and performance programs. This role is great for a motivated individual with great communication and organizational skills, and a knack for customer service who is looking to advance a career in Arts Administration.

About the Mayfair Arts Center  
A project of Chicago Human Rhythm Project, the Mayfair Arts Center (MAC) is a collaborative effort to foster community growth through rhythmic expression. We aim to offer diverse, high\-quality dance and movement classes to the general public while centralizing the education programs, rehearsal space and informal performances of several core groups, as well as supporting additional emerging companies and independent artists. Find out more about the MAC and our core programs at https://www.chicagotap.org/.

Duties:

Facilities Coordination – 50%  
Lead and manage the participation of partners, residents, and space users to be a part of achieving the MAC’s overall goals.  
Maintain service agreements and clearly communicate program policies, procedures, and guidelines.  
In conjunction with MAC Associates, manage class scheduling and all client registration and payments using Wellness Living and ClassBug software.  
Coordinate efforts of staff, intern, and volunteer resources in training in ClassBug and Wellness Living and database maintenance.  
Serve as an active presence at the Mayfair Arts Center (MAC), providing excellent customer service to patrons and guests.  
Assist Core and Community Partners onsite at the MAC.  
Create and maintain CRM registration pages for classes and events at the MAC.  
Field general inquiries by maintaining email inboxes and phones.  
Ensure that the facility is fully operational including electricity, phones, internet, HVAC, printers, snow removal, restrooms, custodial services and others as may be assigned.  
Schedule and supervise building maintenance repair work and assist with checking installation and servicing building equipment.  
Ensure compliance with state and federal regulations, and assist with energy management. Oversee security of buildings and grounds.  
Maintain ongoing communication with contractors, clients, and team.

Program Coordination – 40%  
Assist with the planning and execution of CHRP’s core and seasonal programs. Communicate with internal and external partners to coordinate venue rental, staffing, production support, box office management, and marketing.  
Create and maintain program event pages.  
Oversee box office and ticketing for ticketed events and programs.  
Manage guest artists and faculty, delivering contracts, executing riders, coordinating travel and lodging, and ensuring accurate payment.  
Other duties as assigned – 10%

Qualifications:  
Bachelor’s Degree or commensurate experience.  
2 – 5 years experience in arts administration, production management, and/or facility management.  
Excellent communication and organizational skills.  
Temperament and personality appropriate for a team\-based, customer\-service environment. Knowledge of general maintenance methods, operating requirements, and safety precautions related to facilities management.  
Must be a well\-organized and customer oriented self\-starter.

Send resume and cover letter to:  
Email: info@chicagotap.org

Pay: $22\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 24\.0 per week

jobs.title: Member Experience & Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Pup Social is looking for an experienced, energetic, and sales\-driven **Member Experience \& Sales Coordinator** to join our growing Chicago team.

This hybrid role combines **member and guest relations, sales, tours, service consultations, marketing activations, and brand representation**. You’ll work closely with our operations and marketing teams while directly contributing to membership growth and service revenue.

We’re looking for someone who loves hospitality, dogs, but is equally passionate about **sales, business development, and achieving measurable results**, and who wants to grow with Pup Social as we continue expanding.

Key Responsibilities, Sales \& Member Growth

* Manage incoming leads and maintain consistent follow\-up by phone, text, email, and CRM.
* Conduct engaging in\-person and virtual tours.
* Present and sell memberships, daycare packages, grooming, training, events, and other services.
* Consult guests and members on services and packages that best fit their needs.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, package replenishment, renewals, and cross\-selling.
* Meet and exceed individual sales goals and quotas.
* Maintain an organized sales pipeline and accurate CRM records.
* Build strong relationships with prospects and existing members to support retention and long\-term growth.

Member \& Guest Experience

* Provide a welcoming, polished experience for members and guests at the club.
* Support front desk operations, including check\-ins, bookings, purchases, account questions, and service recommendations.
* Respond to calls, texts, emails, and in\-person inquiries with urgency and professionalism.
* Maintain strong knowledge of Pup Social memberships, services, promotions, events, and policies.
* Work collaboratively with front desk, operations, service, and marketing teams.

Marketing \& Brand Activations

* Represent Pup Social at on\-site and off\-site events, partnerships, and promotional activations.
* Engage prospective customers, generate leads, and confidently communicate the Pup Social experience.
* Support marketing campaigns, promotions, product/service launches, and community initiatives.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* **8\+ years** of customer service, account management, hospitality, retail, reception/front desk, or similar guest\-facing experience, including leadership experience such as Assistant Manager, Manager, or Supervisor.
* **2\+ years of sales experience.**
* Proven ability to meet sales goals, quotas, or revenue targets.
* Previous experience working with a **CRM platform**.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and follow\-up skills.
* Confidence conducting tours, consultations, and sales conversations.
* Ability to work **on\-site Tuesday–Saturday**.
* Comfortable working around dogs of all sizes and breeds in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred:**

* HubSpot and/or Salesforce experience.
* Membership, hospitality, fitness, lifestyle, luxury service, or retail sales experience.
* Experience with marketing activations, experiential marketing, product promotions, or promotional/modeling work.

Compensation \& Perks

* **$38,000 annual base salary**
* Generous **quarterly commission structure**
* Opportunity to earn approximately **$54,000–$100,000\+ annually** based on sales performance
* Additional **year\-end performance bonus**
* Benefits eligibility after **60 days**, with 25% employer contribution
* Complimentary monthly **Pup Social family membership for up to two dogs**
* Bring your dog to work **up to three days per week**, subject to club requirements
* **Up to 30% discount** on eligible products, bar purchases, and services for you, friends, and family
* Sales coaching and professional development
* Opportunity for career advancement as Pup Social expands

About Pup Social

Pup Social is a lifestyle and social club built around dogs and the people who love them. Our Chicago club combines supervised off\-leash play, daycare, grooming, training, coworking, hospitality, events, and community experiences under one roof.

We’re looking for someone who is **relationship\-driven, motivated by sales, accountable for results, and excited to grow their career alongside an expanding brand. If it sounds like you, submit your resume and cover letter to culture@pupsocial.com.**

Pay: $38,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Tell us \- what makes you passionate about sales \& business development?
* Tell us \- why would you like to work at Pup Social?

jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us**


Family Entertainment Group (FEG), is a recognized industry leader in designing, developing, and operating world\-class family entertainment centers and amusement experiences. With a commitment to innovation and guest satisfaction, FEG partners with top brands and venues to create memorable experiences for families and guests of all ages. The Company provides turnkey outsourced facility management and arcade operations services for resorts, hotels, casinos, and amusement parks. Additionally, the Company owns and operates standalone family entertainment centers under the In The Game, Max Action, and Bonkers brands. The Company operates nearly 90 locations throughout the U.S.

**Position Summary**


The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the hands\-on, point\-to\-point movement of shipments and equipment across all Family Entertainment Group locations, including obtaining freight quotes directly from manufacturers and setting up and coordinating wrap\-and\-roll freight for asset transfers. This is an individual\-contributor role: the Coordinator executes logistics tasks directly , and reports to the Parts \& Service Manager. When logistics volume allows, which is the minority of the role, the Coordinator also supports the Parts \& Service department with picking, packing, and shipping parts, fielding service calls, and general department assistance.

**Key Responsibilities – Logistics (Primary)**

* Coordinate all point\-to\-point logistics for shipments, equipment, and assets moving between manufacturers, corporate, and field locations.
* Obtain and compare freight quotes directly from manufacturers for shipments to individual locations, selecting the best combination of cost and transit time.
* Set up and coordinate wrap\-and\-roll freight for game and equipment transfers between locations.
* Book and schedule freight shipments for asset transfers between locations.
* Track shipments in transit and proactively communicate ETAs, delays, and exceptions to the field and Parts \& Service Manager and affected locations.
* Prepare and review shipping documentation, including bills of lading, freight quotes, and tracking information, for accuracy.
* Negotiate rates and service terms with carriers and freight forwarders to control shipping costs.
* Maintain organized records of freight quotes, carrier contacts, and shipment history.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to reduce freight costs, transit times, and shipping errors.

**Key Responsibilities – Parts \& Service Support (Secondary)**

* Assist with picking, packing, and shipping parts orders to field locations.
* Assist with receiving, organizing, labeling, and storing parts inventory, maintaining proper par levels.
* Take and route incoming service calls from field technicians.
* Assist field technicians with parts identification, handling, and ordering processes.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory audits as needed.
* Assist with RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processing with manufacturers as needed.
* Provide general support to the Parts \& Service department as directed by the Parts \& Service Manager.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in logistics, freight coordination, shipping/receiving, or transportation coordination.
* Experience obtaining and comparing freight quotes; familiarity with LTL/FTL and wrap\-and\-roll freight preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines at once.
* Clear, proactive verbal and written communication with carriers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams.
* Comfortable using basic computer and database tools (Excel, inventory or ERP systems).
* Willingness and ability to take on secondary duties, including picking/packing parts, fielding service calls, and general department support.
* Must be physically capable of lifting 50\+ lbs and working in warehouse conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required; additional training in logistics or supply chain is a plus.

jobs.title: Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

Our Business Development Coordinator is responsible for generating new business opportunities by researching target accounts, identifying prospective clients and decision\-makers, engaging prospects, and qualifying opportunities. This role serves as the front line of the sales organization, with a focus on new business development, relationship building, and creating a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for Business Development Managers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Lead Generation and Prospecting**

* Research target accounts, industries, companies, and decision\-makers to identify new business opportunities.
* Develop and organize prospect lists using available research, CRM, LinkedIn, networking, and other business development resources.
* Tailor outreach based on prospect research, business needs, and potential opportunities.
* Generate through outreach.

**Lead Qualification**

* Gather and document information about prospect needs, timing, business priorities, and potential fit.
* Ensure all leads passed to BDMs meet qualification standards.

**Pipeline Development**

* Coordinate discovery calls and meetings for Business Development Managers and ensure relevant prospect information is communicated in advance.
* Assist with preparing presentations, proposals, research, and other materials that support new business opportunities.
* Support pipeline growth by maintaining a steady flow of qualified opportunities

**CRM \& Data Management**

* Maintain data integrity of prospect and account records.
* Accurately log all research and communication activities (calls, emails, meetings).
* Ensure accurate tracking of sales process flow.
* Leverage technology and automation to improve efficiency.

**Collaboration \& Alignment**

* Work closely with Business Development Managers, marketing, and operations to align prospecting efforts and support new business opportunities.
* Ensure prospect information, qualification details, and next steps are clearly communicated during hand\-offs to Business Development Managers.
* Participate in pipeline reviews and weekly planning sessions.


Requirements:
**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1\-3\+ years of experience in business development, sales, sales support, customer\-facing, research, or a related role.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and engage with prospects.
* Proactive and self\-motivated with a results\-driven mindset.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite) and sales prospecting tools, such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Ability to understand and articulate complex products or services to a B2B audience.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of lead generation best practices and tools.

**Position Type / Expected Hours of Work:**  

This is a full\-time position with a typical workweek of 40 or more hours, with additional hours as needed to support business operations. Employees may be eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement, based on their proven track record and location eligibility. This role requires up to 30% travel.

**Physical Demands:**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Must also have ability to sit and stand appropriately for 8 or more hours at a time. Occasionally lifting 25\-50 lbs.

**Expected Salary Range:**


The expected salary range offered for this position is $55,400\-$80,440\.80 annually. Actual pay will be adjusted based on various factors including but not limited to, experience, role\-related knowledge and skills, relevant education or training, geographic location, and other job\-related factors as permitted by law. Depending on the position offered, the compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of a discretionary bonus or commissions.

**More About Let’s Pave**


Let's Pave is a leading paving, roofing, and fencing services contractor with enterprise customers throughout North America. Through driving information technology, management consulting and creative capabilities, we deliver vision, execution and value with an outstanding customer experience, business optimization and industry solutions.


Our work enables clients to improve productivity and competitiveness; grow and strengthen relationships with stakeholders and partners; and reduce costs. Let’s Pave professionals serve clients from a network of offices across North America.

**We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and professional growth, including:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-covered life insurance with optional buy\-up for additional coverage
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Unlimited paid time off (PTO) starting day one of employment
* Hybrid work environment
* Employee growth and development program to support your career advancement


Join our team and enjoy a workplace that values your success and work\-life balance! \#LI\-DNI

jobs.title: Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**


PHOENIX, founded in 1890 and headquartered in Aurora, IL, is a privately held, full\-service manufacturing firm. We specialize in injection\-molded closures serving a wide range of industries. Our mission is to provide the highest level of product quality and support to our customers. We’ve experienced continuous growth over our long history and due to an internal move, we are looking to strengthen our team.


We’re looking for an Account Coordinator to join PHOENIX. This hybrid role involves building success through dependability, service, and action. Working with our National Account Managers, you will communicate customer needs across departments to ensure timely product delivery and drive overall customer satisfaction and success.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Customer success – ensure that we are providing exceptional service to our B2B customers and proactively address updates, issues or concerns.
* Manage the order process with your customer from receipt and entry, through any changes or expediting requests and continue to communicate and assist through shipment of the order
* Maintain customer database including set up of new customers, updating addresses and contacts, along with any customer requirements or instructions
* Develop understanding of how we internally process, schedule, manufacture, inventory, and ship customer orders for your key accounts.
* Work with sales and scheduling to maintain inventory of customer stocks and current forecast
* Provide closure recommendations and request samples through Salesforce
* Request quotes and manage pricing through ERP system
* Collaborate with other departments to resolve client issues, and participate with new/challenging customer projects
* Provide support to National Account Managers by assisting with new business development and coordinate product conversions as needed
* Manage other customer requests such as new part numbers, regulatory documentation, or specifications
* Provide back\-up within the department

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Performs other duties that may be assigned from time to time;
* Responsible for following all Safety Rules, policies, procedures and work instructions;
* Responsible for following all Food Safety related policies and procedures;
* Backup: Front Desk and Sample Room as needed


Requirements:
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**


Proven experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Sales, particularly in the manufacturing industry. Bachelor’s degree preferred.

**SKILLS \& KEY COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities
* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Proactive approach to identifying opportunities for customer success and growth.
* Proficient in Office 365; experience with DW/IQMS and Salesforce, a plus

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* Pushing or Pulling (60\-lbs. typically 0\-15% of the day) \- boxes, printers, computers/monitors
* Lifting or Carrying (0\-35 lbs. typically 0\-15% of the day) \- boxes, printers
* Fine Manipulating (typically over 70% of the day) \- computer usage

**EQUIPMENT USED:**

* Computer, Phone, Scanner/Printer

**CONTACTS:**

* Sales, Warehouse/Shipping, Scheduling/Purchasing, Engineering, Accounting \& MIS

**SUPERVISION:**

* Reports to Director of Customer Success

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**



HirexHire (pronounced hire by hire) is a Chicago\-based recruiting and talent consultancy that integrates with companies short\-term to provide long\-term talent solutions. We take a seat in our client’s everyday operations to understand their people's goals, gaps, and challenges. We then develop and implement the processes and technologies to execute a sustainable and scalable talent plan.



We partner with companies expecting or experiencing high growth that need to hire at scale or fill a critical role rapidly. Our clients are not looking for quick\-fix placements but are thoughtfully building a hiring strategy to scale their businesses.


**Location:** Remote within the Chicagoland area, with occasional in\-person team meetings and events  

**Compensation:** $45,000 \- $60,000 annually \+ bonus eligibility  

**Company Size:** 6 employees

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**



As a Recruiting Coordinator, your focus is on supporting all aspects of the full lifecycle recruiting process in collaboration with our Recruiting Consultants, clients, and candidates. You can expect to help write job descriptions and manage job postings, source and screen resumes, coordinate interviews, and create, send, and collect offers and onboarding documents for our customers.



This person will be one of two primary points of contact for our clients regarding candidates in process, interview scheduling, and overall pipeline activity and metrics. There will be many different people to meet and work with, so we look for candidates who are genuinely interested in our clients’ teams and cultures and attentive to the needs of others. Our team is small and growing, so you can expect to wear many hats and take ownership of broader organizational initiatives to improve our operations and services.

  


**ABOUT YOU**


* You thrive in a high\-paced environment and work well with other like\-minded people
* You are thoughtful, accountable, and jump at opportunities to work on various internal projects
* You’re motivated by building teams in an evolving organization and enjoy seeing the direct results of your work
* You’re able to manage competing priorities while staying organized and maintaining a positive candidate experience
* You’re interested in growing with a company and contributing to the continued development of its recruiting function

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**


* Support Recruiting Consultants and clients across all stages of the recruiting process, ensuring strong organization, communication, and follow\-through
* Assist with role intake, job description development, sourcing, candidate screening, interview coordination, offers, and onboarding support
* Develop and manage job postings across appropriate channels to attract qualified, targeted talent
* Source, screen, and assess candidates while building and maintaining strong, diverse talent pipelines
* Coordinate and facilitate phone, video, and in\-person interviews, ensuring an efficient and organized interview process
* Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates and hiring managers, providing transparency throughout the recruiting lifecycle
* Track recruiting activity and key performance metrics, delivering regular updates and insights to stakeholders

  

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum 2 years of recruiting experience in a recruiting coordinator, recruiting assistant, sourcing, or similar corporate or agency recruiting role
* Experience supporting recruitment for technical talent \- such as software engineers, developers, and IT professionals \- and the ability to understand technical concepts, tools, and roles
* Excellent customer service and confidence communicating with hiring managers, candidates, and cross\-functional partners
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, Workable, Ashby, and LinkedIn Recruiter
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset with a strong bias toward action
* Experience supporting a software, technology, start\-up, or venture capital or private equity\-backed organization is a plus

  

### **BENEFITS**


* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible Remote Work Environment
* Unlimited PTO
* Your Choice of New Technology (Mac or Windows)
* Quarterly Team Outings

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator- Psychiatry Full Time Days
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Operations Coordinator Psychiatry**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


This position will report to the Practice Manager or Director and will be responsible for managing the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising clinical and administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, manage practice collections, ensure service excellence and perform service recovery as necessary.


Position manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks. Responsible for front\-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity. Position may perform staff work in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.


Responsibilities:

* Supervise and direct the office’s front\-line clinical and clerical staff.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
* Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
* Manage providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
* Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co\-pays and patient balances, in\-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
* Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
* Manage office and medical surgical supplies within budget.
* Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
* Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis.
* Attend and actively participate in manager/supervisor meetings.
* Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.

*Additional Functions:*

* Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
* Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
* Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one to one coaching and mentoring.
* Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc).
* Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with procedures.
* Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost\-savings, and operational efficiencies.
* Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed to support the practice.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**  

Required

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of three years work experience in a medical or related business.
* Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO, PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid.
* Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office.
* Leadership experience.
* Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel.
* Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.


Preferred

* Clinical experience as an MA, LPN, or RN.
* Knowledge of CPT and ICD\-9 coding.
* Supervisory experience.

  

**Additional Information**  

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**


Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

**Benefits**


We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Please visit our Benefits section to learn more.

jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Pernix International**  

Pernix International is a dynamic and growing global construction company, delivering highly specialized projects with integrity and exceptional quality.  

  

**PROCUREMENT COORDINATOR**  

Our Procurement Coordinator will be responsible for the initial onset of our RFQ/RFP process and support of our corporate buyers. Candidates must have a minimum of 1\-3 years of solid assistant experience. Experience in construction is a plus. Candidates must have the ability to research/source vendors that ensure quality, price, delivery and service at a price that maximizes company budgets while maintaining the highest code of ethics and conduct. Work hours are 8\-5 pm (or agreed upon time w/Manager) – work from home on Fridays after 60 days.  

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Prepare Request for Quotations/Invitations to Bid (RFQs/ITBs) bid packages based on commodity assignment.
* Obtain solicitations/bids from sources of supply.
* Follow\-up on all RFQ packets and/or all bidders to ensure bids are received in a timely fashion (per required timeline) in support of buyers
* Maintain constant communication with all stakeholders on buyout packages.
* Receive and review bid packages with buyers to ensure bids are complete.
* Generate purchase orders in Purchase Order system (ViewPoint) and log Purchase Orders into Material Tracking Report once decisions are made by buyers.
* Assist buyers in sending award/release Purchase Orders to Vendor(s); follow up with awardee to ensure Order Acknowledgement is sent.
* Attend daily Procurement/Logistics meetings and other meetings (as requested).
* Perform daily quality control (QC) checks on purchase orders and/or reports for other team members (as needed).
* Other duties as assigned.

 **Experience, Education and Skills**
* Minimum two\-year Degree in related field is a must (Business Administration preferred). Prior experience will be considered.
* Must have a minimum of 1\-3 years of solid admin/assistance experience, preferably in the construction industry. However, we are willing to take on the right recent college graduate majoring in supply chain management or seasoned admin assistant.
* Must have a good understanding of procurement techniques/requirements.
* Must have the ability to learn and follow Procurement/Logistics policies and procedures.
* Must have strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Must be well organized, detail\-oriented and highly motivated.
* Must be able to work independently with minimum supervision.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
* Must have impeccable customer service skills. In our area of the business, we treat everyone as a customer.
* Must be able to evaluate and use relevant information along with individual judgment to suggest ways to improve work processes (Process Improvement).

 **Key Requirements**
* U.S. Citizenship is REQUIRED.
* Must be able to secure and maintain a security clearance at the required level
* Must be a team player and look at challenges as opportunities for new knowledge and growth


We offer an excellent benefits package, including Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, Short and Long\-Term Disability, Life Insurance, 17 PTO days as well as matching 401k.
